Kırk parça, her biri on altı kare

10 bileklik, 10 kolye, 10 küpe ve 10 broş: hepsi 14K sarı altın. Her parça atölye kapısından geçti: tezgâh sırası, malzeme listesi, arıza modları ve toleranslar aşağıda. Hero görseller üretildi; geri kalan 15 karenin promptları, her birinin Etsy'deki işiyle birlikte burada.

Nasıl üretilir

  1. Higgsfield'da model nano_banana_2_1, oran 4:3, çözünürlük 2k (açıkça seç; varsayılan 1k), düşünme high, adet 1.
  2. 01 hero referanssız üretilir. 02–16 için o ürünün hero kırpımını (images/heroes/crops/<ID>.jpg) tek referans olarak ekle.
  3. Promptu olduğu gibi yapıştır. Kare promptla çelişiyorsa cümleyi sertleştirme, aynı promptla bir kez daha dene; ikinci kez de tutmazsa pozu değiştir.
  4. 09 numaralı karede kutu sade fildişi karton olarak tarif edildi. Kendi kutun farklıysa kutunun fotoğrafını ikinci referans olarak ekle.
  5. 11 ve 13 numaralı karelerde boş bırakılan alana mm ölçüsünü ya da motifin hikâyesini sonradan yaz.

16Mağaza ızgarası / Pinterest: koyu jade zeminde yüksek kontrast kare.

Etsy metni

Başlık 84/140

14K Gold North Star Bracelet, Lab Grown Sapphire, Eight Pointed Star, Christmas Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, north star bracelet, lab grown sapphire, eight point star, guiding star, star of bethlehem, celestial jewelry, franco chain, star bracelet, christmas gift, gift for her, graduation gift, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, 14k gold franco chain, lab grown white sapphire

Açıklama

A single eight-pointed North Star in 14k gold on a fine Franco chain, with one lab grown white sapphire flush set at its centre. It works as a Christmas gift and keeps its meaning all year: a guiding star for a new job, a move or a graduation.

THE PIECE
One flat star, 11.0 mm tip to tip and 1.1 mm thick, with eight straight arms of equal length. Each arm carries a low centre ridge with two polished facets and ends in a rounded 1.0 mm tip, so nothing catches on knitwear. A raised round hub 3.4 mm wide sits at the centre. The two arms that point along the chain carry the chain rings, so the star sits face up. Franco chain 1.5 mm on both sides, high polish.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.45 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.45 g in total with the stone. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphire, about 0.017 ct, flush set in the hub so its table sits level with the gold. A small hole under the stone lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The star, its hub and both chain rings are cast in 14k gold as one piece, then filed, faceted and polished. There is no solder in the station; every join made at the bench is closed with a laser weld. The stone setting is cut and the stone is set after polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 cm + 2.0 cm uzatma (17.5 / 18.5 cm halkalari). Yildiz 11.0 mm uc-uca, cekirdek sekizgen r 2.4 (vadi kirisi 1.84), 8 kol esit; kol ucu 1.0 mm R0.5 (tum kollar). Plaka: cekirdek 1.1 mm duz; kollarda orta sirt 1.1 mm, iki faset, faset kenari bitmis 0.75 mm (>=0.7); zincir eksenindeki 2 tasiyici kolun son 1.0 mm'si fasetsiz 1.1 mm. Model +0.2 bitirme +0.1 elmas tiras. Gobek O3.4 x 1.5 mm, alttan O0.8 delik. C-halkalar 1.0 kesit, ID1.2, bosluk 0.9 mm. Istasyon eksen boyu C-halkalarla 16.2 mm. Franco 1.5 mm x 13.48 cm.

Yildiz + gobek + iki C-halka TEK PARCA dokulur (standart 14KY, firina girmez). C-halkalar zincir eksenindeki iki karsi kolun ucuna (1.0 x 1.1 fasetsiz kok) entegre; Franco uc halkalarina gecirilip kapatilir ve LAZERLE kaynaklanir (lehim yok). Tas gobekte, altta O0.8 delikli. Hollow yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: +0.2 mm bitirme payi (+0.1 mm elmas tirasli yuzlerde); C-halkalar 0.9 mm bosluklu (gecen zincir uc halkasi teli <= 0.8 mm + 0.1; tel capi tedarikciden yazili alinir); tum giyilen uclar R>=0.4
  2. 2. Recine baski -> yatirim -> vakum dokum, standart 14K sari dokum alasimi (bu parca firina girmez; Zn serbest)
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu
  4. 4. Tesviye + on-cila (0.15-0.20 mm alinir)
  5. 5. Elmas tiras (diamond-cut) faseta: her kolda orta sirt + iki duz faset, faset kenari bitmis >=0.75 mm (kumpas); tasiyici 2 kolun son 1.0 mm'si fasetsiz birakilir; uc yaricaplari R0.5 korunur
  6. 6. Pilot cukurdan O0.8 alt delik del (gobek); flush yuva frezesi (koni, rondist 0.02 mm bindirme)
  7. 7. 1 x 1.5 mm lab-grown tas SOGUK oturtma, el burnisheri ile kenar itme
  8. 8. C-halkalari Franco uc halkalarina gecir, kapat, LAZER kaynak (lehim yok)
  9. 9. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; dikisler lazer kaynak (lehim yok)
  10. 10. Son cila (ultrasonik serbest)
  11. 11. QC: tarti vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, faset kenari >=0.75 ve tasiyici kol ucu 1.0 x 1.1 kumpas olcumu, C-halka boslugu 0.9 (zincir uc halkasi teli <=0.8), tas sikilik (igne ile itme), 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme testi, 250px kucuk resim kontrolu

Malzeme listesi

  • Dokum alasimi standart 14KY: bitmis istasyon(lar) + dokum C-halkalar 0.805 g x1.15 = 0.93 g
  • Tas: 1 x 1.5 mm lab-grown beyaz safir ~0.017 ct
  • Zincir: Franco 1.5 mm 14K solid 13.48 cm = 1.89 g (KILITSIZ g/cm; numune tartisi sart)
  • Lobster kopca 14KY 9x5mm, 1 adet: 0.30 g (TAHMIN — tedarikci numunesi tartilacak; zincir kilitsiz alindigi icin yalniz burada sayilir)
  • Atlama halkasi 14KY 1.0mm tel, ID1.5/OD3.5, 4 adet (kilit, 16.5 / 17.5 / 18.5 cm halkalari): 4 x 0.081 = 0.32 g
  • Uzatma zinciri 14KY solid cable 1.2mm, 2 x 6.5mm = 1.3 cm: 0.059 g (kilitsiz g/cm 0.0456)
  • Damga plaketi 14KY 4.0x2.5x0.6mm (14K + tescilli marka, lazer kazima): 0.073 g
  • TOPLAM ALTIN 3.45 g (bant 3.2-3.9); terazide toplam 3.45 g. Gram kurulumu: 8 kollu yildiz plaka 11.0mm, r_ic 2.4, uc 1.0 R0.5; cekirdek duz 1.1, kollarda sirt 1.1 / faset kenari 0.75 (ort 0.925); tasiyici 2 kolun son 1.0 mm'si duz 1.1: cekirdek 16.29mm2 x1.1 + 8 kol x 4.340mm2 x0.925 + 0.4mm3 duz uc = 50.44mm3 x0.01307 = 0.659 g | Gobek kabartmasi O3.4 x +0.4 (1.5mm ev sahibi): pi*1.7^2*0.4 = 3.63mm3 x0.01307 = 0.047 g | Tas yuvasi + 0.8 alt delik (cikarma): -0.81mm3 x0.01307 = -0.011 g | 2 x dokum C-halka (1.0mm kesit, ID1.2; gercek torus, gomulme dusulmus): 4.2mm3 x2 x0.01307 = 0.110 g | Zincir franco15, 13.48 cm (KILITSIZ g/cm secildi, kilit ayrica sayiliyor): Franco 1.5 kilitsiz 0.140 g/cm (U.S. Jewels 16in 6.1 g ve 7in 2.9 g farkindan; eski 0.1501 kilit dahildi) x 13.48cm = 1.887 g | Lobster 14KY 9x5mm (satin alma, TAHMIN; zincir g/cm KILITSIZ alindigi icin kilit burada BIR kez sayilir): tedarikci tartisi bekleniyor = 0.300 g | 4 x atlama halkasi 1.0mm tel ID1.5 (kilit, 16.5, 17.5, 18.5): 2*pi^2*1.25*0.5^2=6.17mm3 x4 x0.01307 = 0.322 g | Uzatma zinciri cable 1.2mm 2x6.5mm (kilitsiz g/cm): 0.0456 g/cm x1.3cm = 0.059 g | Damga plaketi 4.0x2.5x0.6 (14K+tescilli marka): 5.57mm3 x0.01307 = 0.073 g

Etsy metni

Başlık 86/140

14K Gold Icicle Fringe Bracelet, Seven Solid Gold Drops, Winter Christmas Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, icicle bracelet, fringe bracelet, gold drop bracelet, winter jewelry, icicle jewelry, cable chain bracelet, dainty bracelet, layering bracelet, christmas gift, gift for her, new year gift, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, 14k gold cable chain

Açıklama

Seven solid 14k gold icicles hang from the centre of a fine cable chain, graded from 8 mm at the ends to 12 mm in the middle. A winter Christmas gift that moves with the wrist and still looks right in spring as a simple gold fringe.

THE PIECE
Seven solid tapered drops, 8, 9, 10, 12, 10, 9 and 8 mm long, spaced 3.0 mm centre to centre for a fringe about 20 mm wide. Each drop is 2.2 mm wide at the top and narrows to a rounded 0.8 mm tip, with a shallow spiral line on its upper part and a high polish. Each one hangs from its own small gold loop on a 1.2 mm cable chain and swings freely.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.37 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.37 g in total. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each icicle is cast in 14k gold in one piece with its loop, then polished and given its spiral line. There is no solder: each loop is closed around its chain link with a laser weld, and so is every other join made at the bench.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 cm + 2.0 cm uzatma. 7 sarkit: 8-9-10-12-10-9-8 mm, taban O2.2, uc O0.8 R0.4; spiral oluk <=0.10 mm derin, ~0.3 mm genis, adim 1.5 mm, uca 2.0 mm kala biter (ucta O0.8 tam kesit korunur). Merkez-merkez 3.0 mm (komsu arasi 0.8 mm), sacak genisligi ~20.2 mm. Aralik cable baklasi adimina baglidir: hedef bakla adimi 1.5 mm, her 2. bakla = 3.0 mm; tedarikci adimi farkliysa (or. 1.2 mm) her 3. bakla = 3.6 mm kullanilir (sacak ~24 mm). C-kulp 1.0 kesit, ID1.2, bosluk 0.8. Cable 1.2 mm x 15.10 cm.

Her sarkit ust C-kulpuyla birlikte TEK PARCA ve dolu dokulur (hollow yok). C-kulp zincirin belirlenmis 7 cable baklasina gecirilir, kapatilir ve LAZERLE kaynaklanir (lehim yok). Sarkitlar serbest sallanir.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: +0.2 mm bitirme payi; C-kulplar 0.8 mm bosluklu (cable bakla teli 0.35 + 0.1 = 0.45 <= 0.8); tum giyilen uclar R>=0.4
  2. 2. Recine baski -> yatirim -> vakum dokum, standart 14K sari dokum alasimi (bu parca firina girmez; Zn serbest)
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu
  4. 4. Tesviye + on-cila (0.15-0.20 mm alinir)
  5. 5. Spiral oluk: <=0.10 mm derin, uca 2.0 mm kala biter; yuksek parlatma; tirastan sonra uc O0.8 R0.4 kumpasla olculur
  6. 6. Tedarikciden cable 1.2 bakla adimini yazili al; 3.0 mm (gerekirse 3.6 mm) araliga gore 7 baklayi isaretle; C-kulplari gecir, kapat, LAZER kaynak (lehim yok)
  7. 7. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; dikisler lazer kaynak (lehim yok)
  8. 8. Son cila (ultrasonik serbest)
  9. 9. QC: tarti vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, spiral oluk derinligi <=0.10 ve uc O0.8, sarkit araligi (carpismasiz), 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme testi, 250px kucuk resim kontrolu

Etsy metni

Başlık 89/140

14K Gold Comet Bracelet, Ice Blue Enamel, Lab Grown Sapphire, Cuban Chain, Celestial Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, comet bracelet, ice blue enamel, enamel bracelet, lab grown sapphire, celestial jewelry, miami cuban chain, shooting star, vitreous enamel, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold bracelet, station bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold miami cuban chain

Açıklama

One 14k gold comet on a 2.0 mm Miami Cuban chain, its tail inlaid with opaque ice-blue glass enamel and its head set with two lab grown white sapphires. A Christmas gift with a sky theme rather than a holiday one, so it is worn long after the season.

THE PIECE
One station 19 mm long with a slight arch along its length. The head is 5.0 mm wide; its front half is a flat platform 1.6 mm thick that holds the stones. The tail narrows from 3.0 mm at the head to 1.2 mm at the rounded tip. An enamel channel runs along the first 11 mm of the tail inside 0.7 mm gold walls, and the last 3 mm is plain polished gold. Miami Cuban chain 2.0 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.29 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.31 g in total with the enamel and stones. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice-blue. It fills one narrowing channel along the comet tail. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

STONES
Two 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphires, about 0.034 ct together, flush set side by side at the front of the head, level with the gold. Each sits over a small hole that lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel. The stones are set last, after the final firing.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 + 2.0 cm. Istasyon 19.0 mm (bas O5.0 + kuyruk 14.0 mm); C-halkalarla eksen boyu 24.2 mm; R29 mm'ye on-egrili. Bas: on yarisi 1.6 mm DUZ tas platformu, arka yarisi kuyruga dogru 1.6 -> 1.4 mm egim (kubbe yok). Kuyruk 0-11 mm: genislik 3.0->2.3, kalinlik SABIT 1.4. Kuyruk 11-14 mm: genislik 2.3->1.2, kalinlik 1.4->1.0, uc R0.6. Kanal 11 mm, 1.2->0.9 genis, 0.55 derin. Taslar platformda +/-60 derece, merkezden 1.3 mm, aralarinda 0.75 mm. C-halka bosluk 1.1. Cuban 2.0 x 12.68 cm.

Bas + kuyruk + iki C-halka TEK PARCA; cinkosuz 14KY vakum dokum, R29 mm'ye on-egrili. Mine hucresi dokumde birakilir. Hicbir lehim yok. Tas yerleri basin duz on platformunda, kanaldan >=2.4 mm uzakta. C-halkalar pisirimden sonra zincir uc halkalarina kapatilip lazerle kaynaklanir (bastaki dikis mineden 3+ mm, kuyruk ucundaki kanal sonundan 3 mm).

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: hucreler DOKUMDE birakilir (oyma yok), taban fileto R0.2, tum yuzeylere +0.2 mm bitirme payi; C-halkalar 1.1 mm bosluklu (gecen zincir uc halkasi teli <= 1.0 mm + 0.1; tel capi tedarikciden yazili alinir); tas yerine yalniz 0.5 mm pilot cukur (delik pisirimden sonra delinir); R29 on-egri
  2. 2. Recine baski (yuksek cozunurluk DLP, dokulebilir recine) -> yatirim -> cinkosuz 'enamelable' 14K sari (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy esasli; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum dokum
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu (hucre tabanlari 10x lupla; gozenekli parca HURDA, mine altina gozenek girmez)
  4. 4. Tesviye: dis yuzlere on-cila; hucre tabanlari grafit/karbur frezle TEMIZLENIR (derinlik 0.55 olculur, fileto korunur); hamlac lehimi YOK
  5. 5. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) 4 dongu: ~593 C kiraz kirmizisi + %10 H2SO4 asitleme, durulama
  6. 6. Yag alma + saf su; buz mavisi opak mine (<=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon) yas-dolgu kat 1 (hucre derinliginin ~%60'i)
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 780 C, 60-75 sn, kalibre pirometre + termokupl, paslanmaz trivet
  8. 8. Kat 2 dolgu (kenarin hafif ustune kadar); Pisirim 2: 780 C, 60-75 sn
  9. 9. Tasla zimpara (alundum/elmas ped, su altinda): mine yuzeyi altin kenardan 0.10-0.15 mm ASAGIDA bitirilir, derinlik saatiyle olculur
  10. 10. Pisirim 3 (parlatma/flash): 770 C, 40-50 sn — toplam 3 pisirim (KANIT siniri 4)
  11. 11. Asitsiz oksit temizligi (sulfurik/nitrik banyo YOK): fiberglas firca + 3M radyal disk, mine bantla maskeli
  12. 12. Pilot cukurdan O0.8 alt delik del (bas on kenari); flush yuva frezesi (koni, rondist 0.02 mm bindirme)
  13. 13. 2 x 1.5 mm lab-grown tas SOGUK oturtma, el burnisheriyle kenar itme (mine maskeli; mine yaninda cekicli el aleti KULLANILMAZ)
  14. 14. C-halkalari zincir uc halkalarina gecir, yastikli fikstur icinde soguk kapat; dikisi lazerle kaynakla (mine Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siperle maskeli, dusuk guc, hava nozuluyla sogutma, dikis mine kenarindan >=1.5 mm)
  15. 15. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; halka dikisleri lazer kaynak (istasyondan uzakta)
  16. 16. Son cila: mine maskeli, keceli disk + rouge; ultrasonik/buhar YOK, ilik sabunlu su + yumusak firca
  17. 17. QC: tarti (altin+mine+tas) vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, istasyon boyu 19.0 mm, bas platformu 1.6 mm, mine 10x igne deligi/kabarcik taramasi, mine-kenar derinligi min 0.10 mm, C-halka bosluk 1.1 (Cuban uc halkasi teli <=1.0), 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme testi, 250px kucuk resim

Malzeme listesi

  • Dokum alasimi cinkosuz 14KY (yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC): bitmis istasyon(lar) + dokum C-halkalar 1.020 g x1.15 = 1.17 g
  • Mine tozu: opak buz mavisi, <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; dolu 13 mg, tuketim ~40 mg
  • Taslar: 2 x 1.5 mm lab-grown beyaz safir, toplam ~0.034 ct
  • Zincir: Miami Cuban 2.0 mm 14K solid 12.68 cm = 1.51 g (KILITSIZ g/cm; numune tartisi sart)
  • Lobster kopca 14KY 9x5mm, 1 adet: 0.30 g (TAHMIN — tedarikci numunesi tartilacak; zincir kilitsiz alindigi icin yalniz burada sayilir)
  • Atlama halkasi 14KY 1.0mm tel, ID1.5/OD3.5, 4 adet (kilit, 16.5 / 17.5 / 18.5 cm halkalari): 4 x 0.081 = 0.32 g
  • Uzatma zinciri 14KY solid cable 1.2mm, 2 x 6.5mm = 1.3 cm: 0.059 g (kilitsiz g/cm 0.0456)
  • Damga plaketi 14KY 4.0x2.5x0.6mm (14K + tescilli marka, lazer kazima): 0.073 g
  • TOPLAM ALTIN 3.29 g (bant 3.2-3.9); terazide toplam 3.31 g. Gram kurulumu: Bas diski O5.0: on yari 1.6 duz tas platformu, arka yari 1.6->1.4 egim (ort 1.5): 9.82mm2 x1.6 + 9.82mm2 x1.5 = 30.43mm3 x0.01307 = 0.398 g | Kuyruk 14 mm: 0-11mm 3.0->2.3 x1.4 + 11-14mm 2.3->1.2 x1.4->1.0: 29.15*1.4 + 5.25*1.2 = 47.11mm3 x0.01307 = 0.616 g | Mine kanali (cikarma) 11mm x 1.2->0.9 x0.55: 11.55mm2 x0.55 = -6.35mm3 x0.01307 = -0.083 g | 2 tas yuvasi + O0.8 delik (cikarma): -1.62mm3 x0.01307 = -0.021 g | 2 x dokum C-halka (1.0mm kesit, ID1.2; gercek torus, gomulme dusulmus): 4.2mm3 x2 x0.01307 = 0.110 g | Zincir cuban20, 12.68 cm (KILITSIZ g/cm secildi, kilit ayrica sayiliyor): Miami Cuban 2.0 kilitsiz 0.1194 g/cm (0.128 Etsy kilit dahil toplam x 0.933) x 12.68cm = 1.514 g | Lobster 14KY 9x5mm (satin alma, TAHMIN; zincir g/cm KILITSIZ alindigi icin kilit burada BIR kez sayilir): tedarikci tartisi bekleniyor = 0.300 g | 4 x atlama halkasi 1.0mm tel ID1.5 (kilit, 16.5, 17.5, 18.5): 2*pi^2*1.25*0.5^2=6.17mm3 x4 x0.01307 = 0.322 g | Uzatma zinciri cable 1.2mm 2x6.5mm (kilitsiz g/cm): 0.0456 g/cm x1.3cm = 0.059 g | Damga plaketi 4.0x2.5x0.6 (14K+tescilli marka): 5.57mm3 x0.01307 = 0.073 g

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Kanal duvarinin cokmesi/sarkmasi (14K solidus payi dar)Duvar kanal boyunca >=0.70 mm (kuyruk genisligi = kanal + 1.40); pisirim 780 C (KANIT ust siniri 800), termokupl kalibre
Kanal sonunda taban incelmesi -> catlama (orijinalde gizli hata)Kuyruk kalinligi kanal boyunca SABIT 1.4; incelme yalniz kanal bittikten sonra; taban her noktada 0.85
Igne deligi/kabarcik (Zn, gozenek)Cinkosuz sertifikali alasim + vakum dokum + 4 dongu yuzey zenginlestirme; gozenekli parca hurda
Darbede mine kenarinin kirilmasiMine yuzeyi altin kenardan 0.10-0.15 mm asagida; on-egrili disbukey yuzeyde mine basma altinda
Tas oturturken komsu minenin catlamasiTaslar kanaldan >=2.4 mm uzakta, el burnisheri, mine maskeli; taslar son adimda
Az pisirme (sekerimsi/mat mine) — 780 C orta-isi minenin olgunlasma araliginin altindaBOM'da <=780 C'de olgunlasan yumusak mine; renk basina kupon seri oncesi kapidir
Tas yerinde kubbe kenarinin incelmesiBasin on yarisi 1.6 mm duz platform; kubbe kaldirildi

Etsy metni

Başlık 85/140

14K Gold Evil Eye Bracelet, Enamel Nazar Sunburst, Box Chain, Protection Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, evil eye bracelet, nazar bracelet, enamel bracelet, navy enamel, vitreous enamel, protection amulet, sunburst bracelet, box chain bracelet, talisman jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold box chain

Açıklama

A traditional evil eye in kiln-fired glass enamel, set in a 14k gold sunburst on a fine box chain. Given as a Christmas gift, it is a protection charm worn every day of the year.

THE PIECE
One flat round station 11.8 mm wide and 1.4 mm thick, with eight short gold rays that bring it to 15.0 mm across. The rays are 1.6 mm long with rounded 1.0 mm tips. The face carries four enamel cells divided by 0.7 mm gold walls inside a 0.7 mm gold border. The back is flat polished gold. Box chain 1.0 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.68 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.74 g in total with the enamel. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque navy-blue, white and ice-blue. The colours follow the traditional nazar order, from the outside inward: a navy-blue ring, a white ring, an ice-blue ring and a navy-blue centre dot. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 + 2.0 cm. Disk O11.8 x 1.4 mm; 8 isin 2.4->1.0 mm genis, 1.6 mm boy, uc R0.5, 1.0 mm kalin; toplam O15.0; C-halkalarla eksen boyu 20.2 mm. Hucreler (GELENEKSEL nazar sirasi, distan iceri): dis bordur 0.70 (r5.2-5.9) | lacivert halka 0.7 (r4.5-5.2) | duvar 0.70 | beyaz halka 0.8 (r3.0-3.8) | duvar 0.70 | buz mavisi halka 0.7 (r1.6-2.3) | duvar 0.70 | lacivert gozbebegi O1.8 (r0-0.9). Hepsi 0.55 derin, taban 0.85. Arka DUZ. C-halkalar 3 ve 9 yonundeki isin uclarinda, bosluk 0.9. Box 1.0 x 13.08 cm.

Disk + 8 isin + iki C-halka (3 ve 9 yonundeki isin uclarinda, 1.0 x 1.0 kok) TEK PARCA; cinkosuz 14KY vakum dokum. 4 hucre dokumde birakilir. Lehim yok. Zincir pisirimden sonra takilir; C-halka dikisi mineden 2.5 mm uzakta (KANIT >=1.5).

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: hucreler DOKUMDE birakilir (oyma yok), taban fileto R0.2, tum yuzeylere +0.2 mm bitirme payi; C-halkalar 0.9 mm bosluklu (gecen zincir uc halkasi teli <= 0.8 mm + 0.1; tel capi tedarikciden yazili alinir); arka duz
  2. 2. Recine baski -> yatirim -> cinkosuz 'enamelable' 14K sari (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy esasli; yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC), vakum dokum
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu (hucre tabanlari 10x lupla; gozenekli parca HURDA)
  4. 4. Tesviye: dis yuzlere on-cila; hucre tabanlari frezle TEMIZLENIR (derinlik 0.55 olculur, fileto korunur); hamlac lehimi YOK
  5. 5. Yuzey zenginlestirme 4 dongu: ~593 C + %10 H2SO4 asitleme, durulama
  6. 6. Yag alma + saf su; <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon: lacivert (dis halka + gozbebegi), beyaz (orta halka), buz mavisi (ic halka) ayni katta yas-dolgu kat 1 (~%60 derinlik)
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 780 C, 60-75 sn, kalibre pirometre + termokupl
  8. 8. Kat 2 dolgu, uc renk birlikte (4 hucre); Pisirim 2: 780 C, 60-75 sn
  9. 9. Tasla zimpara (su altinda): mine yuzeyi altin kenardan 0.10-0.15 mm ASAGIDA, derinlik saatiyle olculur
  10. 10. Pisirim 3 (parlatma/flash): 770 C, 40-50 sn — toplam 3 pisirim (KANIT siniri 4)
  11. 11. Asitsiz oksit temizligi: fiberglas firca + 3M radyal disk, mine maskeli
  12. 12. C-halkalari box zincir uc halkalarina gecir, yastikli fiksturde soguk kapat; lazer kaynak (Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siper, dusuk guc, hava sogutma, dikis mineden 2.5 mm)
  13. 13. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; lazer kaynak
  14. 14. Son cila: mine maskeli; ultrasonik/buhar YOK
  15. 15. QC: tarti vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, renk sirasi distan iceri lacivert-beyaz-buz mavisi-lacivert kontrolu, mine 10x igne deligi/kabarcik ve beyaz kenar renk kontrolu, mine-kenar derinligi min 0.10, isin ucu 1.0 olcumu, 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme, 250px kucuk resim

  • Atlama halkasi 14KY 1.0mm tel, ID1.5/OD3.5, 4 adet (kilit, 16.5 / 17.5 / 18.5 cm halkalari): 4 x 0.081 = 0.32 g

Etsy metni

Başlık 83/140

14K Gold Hamsa Bracelet, Lab Grown Blue Sapphire Eye, Franco Chain, Protection Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, hamsa bracelet, hamsa hand, lab grown sapphire, blue lab sapphire, franco chain, protection amulet, talisman jewelry, hamsa charm, christmas gift, gift for her, new year gift, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, 14k gold franco chain, lab grown blue sapphire

Açıklama

A 14k gold hamsa hand with a pale ice-blue lab grown sapphire set as the eye in its palm, on a fine Franco chain. A Christmas gift that carries straight into the new year as an everyday protection charm.

THE PIECE
One flat hamsa 10.0 mm wide, 12.0 mm tall and 1.0 mm thick, with three upright fingers, two outward-curving thumbs and a polished bevelled edge. All tips are fully rounded. In the palm a raised gold almond outline 6.5 mm wide frames a small domed boss that holds the stone. The chain attaches at the two thumb tips so the hand sits upright. Franco chain 1.3 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.53 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.54 g in total with the stone. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
One 2.0 mm round lab grown sapphire in a pale ice-blue tone, about 0.034 ct, flush set in the boss so its table sits level with the gold. A small hole under the stone lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The hamsa, its eye outline, the stone boss and both chain rings are cast in 14k gold as one piece, then bevelled and polished. There is no solder in the station; every join made at the bench is closed with a laser weld. The stone setting is cut and the stone is set after polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 + 2.0 cm. Hamsa 10.0 x 12.0 x 1.0 mm (avuc 8.0 x 6.0; parmaklar 1.8 mm genis, aralarinda 1.3 mm tam boy acik yarik). Goz kabartmasi O3.4 x 1.8 mm. Badem cerceve merkez hatti 6.5 x 4.8 mm (cevre ~18 mm), kabartma 0.6 genis x 0.4 yuksek; ic acikligi ~5.9 x 4.2 -> kabartmayla bosluk >=0.4 mm (>=0.3). Avucta kenar payi ~0.6 mm. C-halkalar iki basparmak ucunda, bosluk 0.9; eksen boyu 15.2 mm. Franco 1.3 x 13.58 cm.

Hamsa + goz kabartmasi + badem cerceve + iki C-halka (basparmak uclarinda) TEK PARCA, standart 14KY. Avuc dolu plaka, kopru yok; parmaklar arasi yariklar dokumde acik. Tasin altinda O0.8 delik. C-halkalar Franco uc halkalarina LAZERLE kapatilir (lehim yok).

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: +0.2 mm bitirme payi; C-halkalar 0.9 mm bosluklu (gecen zincir uc halkasi teli <= 0.8 mm + 0.1; tel capi tedarikciden yazili alinir); tum giyilen uclar R>=0.4
  2. 2. Recine baski -> yatirim -> vakum dokum, standart 14K sari dokum alasimi (firina girmez)
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu
  4. 4. Tesviye + on-cila (0.15-0.20 mm alinir)
  5. 5. Kenar pahi 0.3 mm + parlatma; badem cerceve kabartmasi (0.4 mm) korunur
  6. 6. Pilot cukurdan O0.8 alt delik del (avuc kabartmasi); flush yuva frezesi (koni, rondist 0.02 mm bindirme)
  7. 7. 1 x 2.0 mm lab-grown mavi safir SOGUK oturtma, el burnisheriyle kenar itme
  8. 8. C-halkalari Franco uc halkalarina gecir, kapat, LAZER kaynak (lehim yok)
  9. 9. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; lazer kaynak (lehim yok)
  10. 10. Son cila (ultrasonik serbest)
  11. 11. QC: tarti vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, badem-kabartma boslugu >=0.3, parmak yarigi 1.3, tas sikilik (igneyle itme), 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme testi, 250px kucuk resim kontrolu

Malzeme listesi

  • Dokum alasimi standart 14KY: bitmis istasyon(lar) + dokum C-halkalar 1.350 g x1.15 = 1.55 g
  • Tas: 1 x 2.0 mm lab-grown mavi safir (acik/buz mavisi ton) ~0.034 ct
  • Zincir: Franco 1.3 mm 14K solid 13.58 cm = 1.43 g (KILITSIZ g/cm; numune tartisi sart)
  • Lobster kopca 14KY 9x5mm, 1 adet: 0.30 g (TAHMIN — tedarikci numunesi tartilacak; zincir kilitsiz alindigi icin yalniz burada sayilir)
  • Atlama halkasi 14KY 1.0mm tel, ID1.5/OD3.5, 4 adet (kilit, 16.5 / 17.5 / 18.5 cm halkalari): 4 x 0.081 = 0.32 g
  • Uzatma zinciri 14KY solid cable 1.2mm, 2 x 6.5mm = 1.3 cm: 0.059 g (kilitsiz g/cm 0.0456)
  • Damga plaketi 14KY 4.0x2.5x0.6mm (14K + tescilli marka, lazer kazima): 0.073 g
  • TOPLAM ALTIN 3.53 g (bant 3.2-3.9); terazide toplam 3.54 g. Gram kurulumu: Hamsa plakasi 10.0x12.0 (avuc 8.0x6.0 + 3 parmak 1.8 genis, aralarinda 1.3 mm tam boy yarik + 2 basparmak) x1.0: (80.90 + 8.0x0.5) = 84.90mm3 x0.01307 = 1.110 g | Goz kabartmasi O3.4 x +0.8 (1.8mm ev sahibi): pi*1.7^2*0.8 = 7.26mm3 x0.01307 = 0.095 g | Badem cerceve kabartma 6.5x4.8 merkez hat (cevre ~18mm) x0.6 x0.4: 18*0.6*0.4 = 4.32mm3 x0.01307 = 0.056 g | 2.0mm tas yuvasi + delik (cikarma): -1.57mm3 x0.01307 = -0.021 g | 2 x dokum C-halka (1.0mm kesit, ID1.2; gercek torus, gomulme dusulmus): 4.2mm3 x2 x0.01307 = 0.110 g | Zincir franco13, 13.58 cm (KILITSIZ g/cm secildi, kilit ayrica sayiliyor): Franco 1.3 kilitsiz 0.1051 g/cm (0.1127 kilit dahil ara deger x 0.933 Franco 1.5 kilit orani) x 13.58cm = 1.427 g | Lobster 14KY 9x5mm (satin alma, TAHMIN; zincir g/cm KILITSIZ alindigi icin kilit burada BIR kez sayilir): tedarikci tartisi bekleniyor = 0.300 g | 4 x atlama halkasi 1.0mm tel ID1.5 (kilit, 16.5, 17.5, 18.5): 2*pi^2*1.25*0.5^2=6.17mm3 x4 x0.01307 = 0.322 g | Uzatma zinciri cable 1.2mm 2x6.5mm (kilitsiz g/cm): 0.0456 g/cm x1.3cm = 0.059 g | Damga plaketi 4.0x2.5x0.6 (14K+tescilli marka): 5.57mm3 x0.01307 = 0.073 g

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Tas kuletinin arkadan tasmasi ve bilekte kirilmasi (orijinal: 1.24 mm derin tas, 1.0 mm plaka)Kabartma 1.8 mm (KANIT 2.0 mm tas icin min 1.8); kulet alttaki delige oturur
Oturtma kuvvetiyle asili diskin egilip tasin gevsemesiAvuc dolu plaka; kabartma plakaya tum cevresinden bagli, kopru yok

Etsy metni

Başlık 87/140

14K Gold Snaffle Bit Bracelet, Green Enamel, Miami Cuban Chain, Equestrian Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, snaffle bit, snaffle bracelet, equestrian jewelry, enamel bracelet, green enamel, vitreous enamel, miami cuban chain, riding jewelry, horse lover gift, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold miami cuban chain

Açıklama

A small 14k gold snaffle bit with a working jointed mouthpiece, its two D cheek pieces inlaid with deep jade-green glass enamel. A Christmas gift for a rider that reads as classic equestrian gold the rest of the year.

THE PIECE
One station 22 mm long. Two flat D-shaped cheek pieces, each 7.5 mm tall, 5.0 mm deep and 1.4 mm thick with a 1.8 mm round hole, are joined by a two-part mouthpiece of 1.5 mm round bars that link through two interlocking loops and move at the centre. Each D carries one curved enamel channel 7.5 mm long and 0.75 mm wide inside 0.7 mm gold walls. Miami Cuban chain 1.8 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.69 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.70 g in total with the enamel. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade-green. It fills one curved channel on each cheek piece; the moving joint carries no enamel. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in two halves, each cheek piece in one piece with its half of the mouthpiece and its chain ring, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 + 2.0 cm. Istasyon 22.2 mm = D 5.0 + bar 3.0 + gecme halkalar (OD4.6 + ID1.6 = 6.2) + bar 3.0 + D 5.0; C-halkalarla eksen boyu 27.4 mm. D plaka 7.5 yuksek x 5.0 derin x 1.4 (dikdortgen 7.5 x 1.25 + yarim daire r3.75); ic delik O1.8, merkezi duz kenardan 1.9 mm -> duz bar 1.0 mm, egri bant tepe noktada 2.2 mm (kanal 0.75 + 2 x 0.70 = 2.15 sigar). Egri kanal ~7.5 mm yay x 0.75 x 0.55, yalniz D tepesinin iki yaninda; dis C-halka D'nin egri tepesinde dis duvara kokludur. Agizlik yarilari O1.5 x 3.0; gecme halkalar 1.5 kesit, ID1.6; sag halka 1.6 mm bosluklu (gecen tel 1.5 + 0.1). Dis C-halka bosluk 1.1. Cuban 1.8 x 12.36 cm.

Her yanak plakasi kendi agizlik yarisi, merkez gecme halkasi ve dis C-halkasiyla TEK PARCA dokulur (iki dokum, cinkosuz 14KY). Sol yarinin merkez halkasi kapali; saginki 1.6 mm bosluklu dokulur. Tum pisirimlerden SONRA sag halka sol kapali halkaya gecirilir, bosluk 14K O1.5 dolgu teliyle doldurulur ve lazerle kaynaklanir (dikis mineden ~5 mm). Soguk kapatma/percin YOK. Mafsal islevsel; mine yalniz rijit D plakalarda.

  13. 13. Dis C-halkalari Cuban uc halkalarina kapat, lazer kaynak (mineden >=1.5 mm)

Stirrup Link Bracelet

14K Gold Stirrup Bracelet, Three Lab Grown Sapphires, Franco Chain, Equestrian Gift for Her

14K sarı altın3.64 g altın3 x 1,5 mm lab beyaz safir

Noel ikonografisi tasimiyor; 'equestrian / stirrup' olarak yil boyu satar, Mayis'taki Kentucky Derby doneminde ikinci tepe yapar.

Etsy metni

Başlık 91/140

14K Gold Stirrup Bracelet, Three Lab Grown Sapphires, Franco Chain, Equestrian Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, stirrup bracelet, equestrian jewelry, lab grown sapphire, franco chain, horse lover gift, station bracelet, riding jewelry, diamond cut gold, derby jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, 14k gold franco chain, lab grown white sapphire

Açıklama

Three small 14k gold stirrups on a fine Franco chain, each with one lab grown white sapphire flush set in its base. A Christmas gift for a rider, and a quiet equestrian piece for every season after it.

THE PIECE
Three flat stations about 13 mm apart: a centre stirrup 8.5 mm tall and two side stirrups 6.5 mm tall. Each is a rounded open arch of diamond-cut gold, 1.3 by 1.1 mm in section, on a flat base bar 1.0 mm thick, with the inner arch mirror-polished. A raised square pad 2.4 mm wide in the middle of each base bar holds the stone. Franco chain 1.3 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.64 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.65 g in total with the stones. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
Three 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphires, about 0.051 ct together, one flush set in each stirrup base so its table sits level with the gold. A small hole under each stone lets light in and keeps the setting clean.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each stirrup is cast in 14k gold as one piece with its pad and both chain rings, then diamond-cut and polished. There is no solder in the stations; every join made at the bench is closed with a laser weld. The stone settings are cut and the stones are set after polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth after wearing. Take it off before swimming and keep it away from chlorine and household chemicals. Warm soapy water and a soft brush will clean the chain and the setting.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 + 2.0 cm. Merkez uzengi: 8.5 yuksek, ic genislik 4.2, tread 7.5 x 1.8 x 1.0, kemer merkez hatti 16.9 mm. Yanlar: 6.5 yuksek, ic genislik 3.2, tread 5.5 x 1.6 x 1.0, kemer merkez hatti 12.3 mm. Kemer bitmis 1.3 x 1.1 (model 1.6 x 1.4; kucuk resim okunurlugu icin 1.2 x 1.0'dan buyutuldu). Tas boss 2.4 x 2.4 x 1.5. Eksen boylari 12.7 / 10.7 / 10.7 mm. Franco 1.3 toplam 11.69 cm, 4 segment: 4.52 + 1.33 + 1.33 + 4.52 cm; istasyonlar arasi 13.3 mm. C-halka bosluk 0.9.

Her uzengi kemer + tread + boss + iki C-halkayla (tread uclarinda) TEK PARCA dokulur, standart 14KY. Boss tread'in ustune kalkar, arka duz; tasin altinda O0.8 delik. C-halkalar Franco segment uclarina LAZERLE kapatilir (lehim yok).

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: +0.2 mm bitirme payi (+0.1 mm elmas tirasli kemerlerde; kemer model 1.6 x 1.4 -> bitmis 1.3 x 1.1); C-halkalar 0.9 mm bosluklu (Franco uc halkasi teli <=0.8 + 0.1); tum giyilen uclar R>=0.4
  2. 2. Recine baski -> yatirim -> vakum dokum, standart 14K sari dokum alasimi (firina girmez)
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu
  4. 4. Tesviye + on-cila (0.15-0.20 mm alinir)
  5. 5. Ic kemer ayna parlatma
  6. 6. Elmas tiras (diamond-cut) faseta, kemer dis yuzleri
  7. 7. Pilot cukurlardan O0.8 alt delik del (3 tread boss'u); flush yuva frezesi (koni, rondist 0.02 mm bindirme)
  8. 8. 3 x 1.5 mm lab-grown tas SOGUK oturtma, el burnisheriyle kenar itme
  9. 9. Franco'yu 4.52 / 1.33 / 1.33 / 4.52 cm kes; C-halkalari segment uc halkalarina gecir, kapat, LAZER kaynak (lehim yok)
  10. 10. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; lazer kaynak
  11. 11. Son cila (ultrasonik serbest)
  12. 12. QC: tarti vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, istasyon araligi 13.3 mm, kemer kesiti 1.3 x 1.1, tas sikilik (igneyle itme), 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme testi, 250px kucuk resim (ana gorsel istasyon yakin cekimi)

Malzeme listesi

  • Dokum alasimi standart 14KY: bitmis istasyon(lar) + dokum C-halkalar 1.662 g x1.15 = 1.91 g
  • Taslar: 3 x 1.5 mm lab-grown beyaz safir, toplam ~0.051 ct
  • Zincir: Franco 1.3 mm 14K solid 11.69 cm = 1.23 g (KILITSIZ g/cm; numune tartisi sart)
  • Lobster kopca 14KY 9x5mm, 1 adet: 0.30 g (TAHMIN — tedarikci numunesi tartilacak; zincir kilitsiz alindigi icin yalniz burada sayilir)
  • Atlama halkasi 14KY 1.0mm tel, ID1.5/OD3.5, 4 adet (kilit, 16.5 / 17.5 / 18.5 cm halkalari): 4 x 0.081 = 0.32 g
  • Uzatma zinciri 14KY solid cable 1.2mm, 2 x 6.5mm = 1.3 cm: 0.059 g (kilitsiz g/cm 0.0456)
  • Damga plaketi 14KY 4.0x2.5x0.6mm (14K + tescilli marka, lazer kazima): 0.073 g
  • TOPLAM ALTIN 3.64 g (bant 3.2-3.9); terazide toplam 3.65 g.     Quiet luxury editorial still-life product photography. Warm ivory linen ground, honed grey stone slab, a sliver of deep jade-green matte card. No text, no logo, no glitter, no Christmas decoration. The piece: 14K yellow gold bracelet on a 1.3 mm Franco chain, 16.5 cm long, 2.0 cm extender. Each stirrup is a rounded arch of 1.3 by 1.1 mm diamond-cut gold on a flat base bar; the chain attaches at both ends of the base bar and the arch extends sideways from the chain. A raised square pad 2.4 mm wide at the middle of each base bar holds one 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphire, flush set. 9 mm lobster clasp. The stones are exactly these and no others: three 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, one flush-set in the square pad at the middle of each stirrup base bar. No other stone and no empty setting anywhere on the piece. The piece has no enamel and no colour: every surface is yellow gold. The decorated centre of the bracelet lies face up at the centre of the honed grey stone slab, close to the camera; the chain runs away from it on both sides in a soft curve and leaves the frame at the left and right edges; the clasp is out of frame. Seen from about 30 degrees above with a 100 mm macro lens, the decorated part in razor-sharp focus, filling about a third of the frame width, with the chain softly out of focus toward the frame edges. No people and no hands.

Kardinal bir anma/ziyaret tilsimi, Noel ikonu degil; 26 Aralik'tan sonra 'cardinal / memorial' olarak satmaya devam eder, Anneler Gunu ikinci tepe yapar.

Etsy metni

Başlık 84/140

14K Gold Cardinal Bracelet, Berry Enamel Bird, Lab Grown Sapphire Eye, Memorial Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, cardinal bracelet, cardinal jewelry, memorial jewelry, enamel bracelet, berry enamel, vitreous enamel, lab grown sapphire, bird bracelet, franco chain, christmas gift, sympathy gift, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold franco chain

Açıklama

A small 14k gold cardinal in profile, its breast inlaid with deep berry glass enamel and a lab grown white sapphire set as its eye. Often chosen as a Christmas gift, the cardinal is also a remembrance bird, which keeps it meaningful all year.

THE PIECE
One flat bird 10.5 mm long, 8.5 mm tall and 1.4 mm thick, with an upright crest, a short beak and a raised tail, all with rounded tips. The body and wing are smooth polished gold, with two small open cut-outs behind the wing and under the tail. The breast is a single enamel field inside a 0.7 mm gold rim. Franco chain 1.5 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.52 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.54 g in total with the enamel and stone. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry (dark purple-red). It fills the single breast cell. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphire, about 0.017 ct, flush set as the eye, level with the gold and 1.2 mm away from the enamel. A small hole behind the stone lets light in.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel. The stone is set last, after the final firing.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 + 2.0 cm. Kus 10.5 x 8.5 x 1.4 mm (goz yerinde 1.5); govde ve kanat duz, parlak, dokusuz altin (kanatta kazima/tuy yok); 2 openwork (kanat arkasi 1.3, kuyruk alti 1.1 mm); gogus hucresi ~14.5 mm2, en dar 1.6 mm, 0.55 derin; cevre duvar 0.70. Tas mineden 1.2 mm. C-halkalar kuyruk ucu ve gogus onunde 1.5 mm ciplak pedde, bosluk 0.9; eksen boyu 15.7 mm. Franco 1.5 x 13.53 cm.

Kus + iki C-halka (1.5 mm ciplak pedler uzerinde) TEK PARCA; cinkosuz 14KY vakum dokum. Hucre dokumde birakilir. Lehim yok. Zincir ve tas pisirimden sonra takilir; C-halkalar lazerle kapatilir.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: hucre DOKUMDE birakilir, taban fileto R0.2, +0.2 mm bitirme payi; gaga/tepelik/kuyruk uclari 0.8 R0.4; C-halkalar 0.9 mm bosluklu (gecen zincir uc halkasi teli <= 0.8 mm + 0.1); goz yerine yalniz 0.5 mm pilot cukur
  2. 2. Recine baski -> yatirim -> cinkosuz 'enamelable' 14K sari (Otto Frei 846-180 esasli, yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC), vakum dokum
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu (hucre tabani 10x; gozenekli parca HURDA)
  4. 4. Tesviye; hucre tabani temizlenir (0.55 olculur); hamlac lehimi YOK
  5. 5. Yuzey zenginlestirme 4 dongu: ~593 C + %10 H2SO4
  6. 6. <=760 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; 760 C kuponunda olgunlasmazsa pisirim 770 C ile sinirlanir (bogurtlen yanmasina karsi en dusuk olgunlasma sicakligi secilir): derin bogurtlen opak mine yas-dolgu kat 1
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 760 C, 60-75 sn, kalibre termokupl
  8. 8. Kat 2; Pisirim 2: 760 C, 60-75 sn
  9. 9. Tasla zimpara (su altinda): yuzey kenardan 0.10-0.15 mm asagida
  10. 10. Pisirim 3 (flash): 760 C, 40-50 sn — toplam 3, hepsi bandin alt ucunda (bogurtlen burnout korumasi)
  11. 11. Asitsiz oksit temizligi, mine maskeli
  12. 12. Goz: pilot cukurdan O0.8 alt delik, flush yuva frezesi
  13. 13. 1 x 1.5 mm lab-grown tas SOGUK oturtma, el burnisheri (mine maskeli; cekicli el aleti KULLANILMAZ)
  14. 14. C-halkalari Franco uc halkalarina gecir, yastikli fiksturde soguk kapat; lazer kaynak (Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siper, dusuk guc, hava sogutma; dikis mineden >=1.5 mm, ciplak ped uzerinde)
  15. 15. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; lazer
  16. 16. Son cila, mine maskeli; ultrasonik/buhar YOK
  17. 17. QC: tarti vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, mine 10x igne deligi + renk (kararma) + olgunlasma (parlaklik) kontrolu, kanat yuzeyi dokusuz, mine-kenar derinligi min 0.10, 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme, 250px kucuk resim

Ice Crystal Hexagon Bracelet

14K Gold Hexagon Ice Crystal Bracelet, Ice Blue Enamel, Lab Grown Sapphire, Winter Gift

Buz kristali kis gorselligi tasir ama Noel ikonu degil; Ocak-Mart 'ice crystal / winter', sonrasinda 'hexagon / geometric' olarak yil boyu satar.

Etsy metni

Başlık 87/140

14K Gold Hexagon Ice Crystal Bracelet, Ice Blue Enamel, Lab Grown Sapphire, Winter Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, ice crystal, hexagon bracelet, enamel bracelet, ice blue enamel, vitreous enamel, lab grown sapphire, geometric jewelry, winter jewelry, franco chain, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold franco chain

Açıklama

A flat 14k gold hexagon, the shape of a plate ice crystal, with a band of pale ice-blue glass enamel around a lab grown white sapphire. A winter Christmas gift that turns into a clean geometric piece once the season is over.

THE PIECE
One flat hexagon 11.0 mm across the corners and 1.4 mm thick, with slightly rounded corners and a 0.8 mm polished gold rim. Inside the rim, one continuous enamel band 2.4 mm wide surrounds a raised gold centre hexagon 3.1 mm across that holds the stone. The chain attaches at the middle of two opposite edges. Franco chain 1.3 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.40 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.46 g in total with the enamel and stone. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque pale ice-blue. It fills one continuous hexagonal band around the gold centre. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab grown white sapphire, about 0.017 ct, flush set in the centre hexagon, level with the gold and 0.8 mm away from the enamel. A small hole under the stone lets light in.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel. The stone is set last, after the final firing.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kapali 16.5 + 2.0 cm. Altigen kose-kose 11.0 / kenar-kenar 9.53 x 1.4 mm (gobekte 1.5); koseler R0.5; bordur 0.80. TEK altigen halka hucre: dis kenar-kenar 7.93, ic sinir = gobek altigeni kenar-kenar 3.1; radyal genislik 2.41 mm (kenar-kenar yonunde), 0.55 derin, taban 0.85, alan ~46.1 mm2. Sirt yok (6 sirtli sektorlu levha kar tanesi okumasi riski nedeniyle kaldirildi). Tas gobekte, mineye 0.8 mm. C-halkalar iki karsi kenarin ortasinda, bosluk 0.9; C-halkalarla eksen boyu 14.7 mm. Franco 1.3 x 13.63 cm.

Altigen + tek halka hucre + gobek + iki C-halka TEK PARCA; cinkosuz 14KY vakum dokum. Hucre ici duz (kabartma/doku yok). Lehim yok. Tas pisirimden sonra gobege takilir. 9.5 mm'lik rijit istasyonun R29'daki sagittasi ~0.4 mm; duz dokulur.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: tek altigen halka hucre DOKUMDE birakilir, taban fileto R0.2, +0.2 mm bitirme payi; altigen koseleri R0.5; C-halkalar 0.9 mm bosluklu (Franco uc halkasi teli <=0.8 + 0.1); gobekte yalniz 0.5 mm pilot cukur
  2. 2. Recine baski -> yatirim -> cinkosuz 'enamelable' 14K sari (Otto Frei 846-180 esasli, yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC), vakum dokum
  3. 3. Yolluk kesimi, gozenek kontrolu (hucre tabanlari 10x; gozenekli parca HURDA)
  4. 4. Tesviye; hucre tabanlari temizlenir (0.55 olculur); hamlac lehimi YOK
  5. 5. Yuzey zenginlestirme 4 dongu: ~593 C + %10 H2SO4
  6. 6. <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon: buz mavisi opak mine yas-dolgu kat 1 (tek halka hucre)
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 780 C, 60-75 sn, kalibre termokupl
  8. 8. Kat 2; Pisirim 2: 780 C, 60-75 sn
  9. 9. Tasla zimpara (su altinda): yuzey kenardan 0.10-0.15 mm asagida
  10. 10. Pisirim 3 (flash): 770 C, 40-50 sn — toplam 3
  11. 11. Asitsiz oksit temizligi, mine maskeli
  12. 12. Gobek: pilot cukurdan O0.8 alt delik, flush yuva frezesi
  13. 13. 1 x 1.5 mm lab-grown tas SOGUK oturtma, el burnisheri (mine maskeli; cekicli el aleti KULLANILMAZ)
  14. 14. C-halkalari Franco uc halkalarina gecir, yastikli fiksturde soguk kapat; lazer kaynak (Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siper, dusuk guc, hava sogutma, dikis mineden >=1.5 mm)
  15. 15. Kopca grubu: lobster + 4 atlama halkasi + uzatma + plaket; lazer
  16. 16. Son cila, mine maskeli; ultrasonik/buhar YOK
  17. 17. QC: tarti vs gram kurulumu +/-3%, mine 10x igne deligi taramasi, mine-kenar derinligi min 0.10, 17.5/18.5 uzunluk, kopca 2 kg cekme, 250px kucuk resim (kar tanesi gibi okunmuyor teyidi)

Malzeme listesi

  • Dokum alasimi cinkosuz 14KY (yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC): bitmis istasyon(lar) + dokum C-halkalar 1.217 g x1.15 = 1.40 g
  • Mine tozu: opak buz mavisi, <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; dolu 52 mg, tuketim ~100 mg
  • Tas: 1 x 1.5 mm lab-grown beyaz safir ~0.017 ct
  • Zincir: Franco 1.3 mm 14K solid 13.63 cm = 1.43 g (KILITSIZ g/cm; numune tartisi sart)
  • Lobster kopca 14KY 9x5mm, 1 adet: 0.30 g (TAHMIN — tedarikci numunesi tartilacak; zincir kilitsiz alindigi icin yalniz burada sayilir)
  • Atlama halkasi 14KY 1.0mm tel, ID1.5/OD3.5, 4 adet (kilit, 16.5 / 17.5 / 18.5 cm halkalari): 4 x 0.081 = 0.32 g
  • Uzatma zinciri 14KY solid cable 1.2mm, 2 x 6.5mm = 1.3 cm: 0.059 g (kilitsiz g/cm 0.0456)
  • Damga plaketi 14KY 4.0x2.5x0.6mm (14K + tescilli marka, lazer kazima): 0.073 g
  • TOPLAM ALTIN 3.40 g (bant 3.2-3.9); terazide toplam 3.46 g. Gram kurulumu: Altigen plaka 11.0 kose-kose (9.53 kenar-kenar) x1.4: 78.59mm2 x1.4 = 110.03mm3 x0.01307 = 1.438 g | Tek altigen halka hucre (cikarma): dis kenar-kenar 7.93, ic gobek 3.1, 0.55 derin: 46.09mm2 x0.55 = -25.35mm3 x0.01307 = -0.331 g | Gobek altigeni +0.1 (1.5 ev sahibi) - tas yuvasi: 8.32mm2 x0.1 - 0.81 = 0.02mm3 = 0.000 g | 2 x dokum C-halka (1.0mm kesit, ID1.2; gercek torus, gomulme dusulmus): 4.2mm3 x2 x0.01307 = 0.110 g | Zincir franco13, 13.63 cm (KILITSIZ g/cm secildi, kilit ayrica sayiliyor): Franco 1.3 kilitsiz 0.1051 g/cm (0.1127 kilit dahil ara deger x 0.933 Franco 1.5 kilit orani) x 13.63cm = 1.432 g | Lobster 14KY 9x5mm (satin alma, TAHMIN; zincir g/cm KILITSIZ alindigi icin kilit burada BIR kez sayilir): tedarikci tartisi bekleniyor = 0.300 g | 4 x atlama halkasi 1.0mm tel ID1.5 (kilit, 16.5, 17.5, 18.5): 2*pi^2*1.25*0.5^2=6.17mm3 x4 x0.01307 = 0.322 g | Uzatma zinciri cable 1.2mm 2x6.5mm (kilitsiz g/cm): 0.0456 g/cm x1.3cm = 0.059 g | Damga plaketi 4.0x2.5x0.6 (14K+tescilli marka): 5.57mm3 x0.01307 = 0.073 g

14K Gold Scarab Bracelet, Green Enamel Beetle Amulet, Cuban Chain, Good Luck Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold bracelet, scarab bracelet, scarab amulet, beetle jewelry, enamel bracelet, green enamel, vitreous enamel, miami cuban chain, good luck gift, talisman jewelry, christmas gift, new beginnings, solid gold bracelet

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold miami cuban chain

Açıklama

A stylised 14k gold scarab with deep jade-green glass enamel wing cases, on a 2.0 mm Miami Cuban chain. The scarab is an old amulet of renewal, so a Christmas gift of it carries naturally into the new year.

THE PIECE
One station 11.0 mm long and 8.0 mm wide including its six legs, with a body 6.4 mm wide and a solid domed back 1.6 mm high. Two enamel wing cases sit either side of a 0.7 mm gold centre line. The front gold shield has five fan-shaped open slits and a row of six raised dots. The underside is flat polished gold. Miami Cuban chain 2.0 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.41 g of 14k gold, counting the station, chain, clasp, rings and tag. On the scale the finished bracelet weighs 3.43 g in total with the enamel. Each piece is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade-green. It fills the two wing-case cells and follows the curve of the dome. The enamel surface sits 0.1 mm below the gold edge, so the gold takes knocks first. Fired glass is hard but can chip under a sharp knock, so take the bracelet off for the gym and the pool, keep it away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.5 cm closed, plus a 2 cm extender with rings at 17.5 and 18.5 cm, so it fits 16.5-18.5 cm. It closes with a 9 mm lobster clasp, and the extender ends in a small tag stamped 14K.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The station is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece with its chain rings, and the enamel cells are formed in the casting itself. There is no solder in the station: the enamel is fired three times, and every join is closed afterwards with a laser weld away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. Store the bracelet on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

Elytra hucreleri 2 x ~10 mm2, genislik ~2.15 (= (6.4 - 2 x 0.70 - 0.70) / 2), 0.55 derin, taban 0.9; omurga 0.70; dis duvar 0.70. On kalkanda 5 yelpaze yarik (0.8 genis) ve 6 nokta (O0.6 x 0.4). 6 bacak 0.8 genis, uc R0.4, bacak araliklari 0.8. C-halkalar bas ve kuyruk ucunda 1.2 mm ciplak pedde, bosluk 1.1; eksen boyu 16.2 mm. Cuban 2.0 x 13.48 cm.

Govde + kubbe + 2 hucre + on kalkan yariklari + bacaklar + iki C-halka TEK PARCA; cinkosuz 14KY vakum dokum. Kubbe DOLU (hollow yok). Yolluk kubbe tepesine konur (kalin kesit, cekinti gozenegi riski). Lehim yok. Yarik ve noktalar yalniz ON KALKANDA (pronotum); hucre ici duz.

Etsy metni

Başlık 81/140

14K Gold Star Pendant Necklace, Openwork Eight Point Guiding Star, Christmas Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, star necklace, guiding star, north star pendant, openwork pendant, eight point star, celestial jewelry, star of bethlehem, christmas gift, gift for her, cable chain necklace, solid gold pendant, diamond cut gold

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

An eight-pointed star drawn in gold: an open rail, eight short spokes and a small round window at the centre, with the lower ray drawn longer. A quiet Christmas gift that keeps being worn long after.

THE PIECE
The star is 18 mm wide and 23 mm tall. Seven rays reach 9 mm from the centre and the lower ray 14 mm. The 1.0 mm rail is diamond-cut on its face; the centre disc is 4.5 mm across with a 2.0 mm hole. The ray tips are rounded. The bail is cast with the star.

GOLD WEIGHT
4.07 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.07 g in total with everything on it.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Yildiz 18.0 x 23.0 mm (7 kol R9.0, alt kol R14.0, vadi r4.2) + kulp D4.0 -> toplam boy ~27 mm. Ray bitmis 1.0 gen x 0.9 kal (model 1.2 x 1.2: +0.2 bitirme, on yuz elmas tiras +0.1). Merkez gobek D4.5 x 1.1, ortada D2.0 yuvarlak delik. 8 vadi kirisi 1.95 x 0.8 x 0.9; alt kol orta kaburgasi 11.25 x 0.8 x 0.9. Kulp kesit 1.0 x 1.6, ic cap 2.0.

Tek parca kayip-mum dokum (ray, kirisler, kaburga, gobek, kulp ayni mumdan; montaj ve lehim yok). 9 pencere (7 kol + uzun kolda kaburganin iki yani) mumdan acik gelir; her pencere ucu, aciklik 0.6 mm'ye indigi yerde 0.3 mm yaricapla biter, otesi kati dolgu (ag/perde olusmasin). Merkezde yildiz deligi YOK; D2.0 yuvarlak delik (1.0 kalinlikta derinlik/genislik 0.55). Mine yok, tas yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis olculer + 0.2 mm bitirme payi, on yuz elmas tiras yuzeylerine +0.1 mm (ray modeli 1.2 x 1.2). Pencere uclari 0.6 mm genislikte r0.3 ile kapatilir.
  2. 2. Mum/recine baski (DLP, 25-50 um katman), destekler arka yuzde; 3 besleme: alt kol ucu arkasi + iki yan kol ucu (ince rayda eksik dolumu onler).
  3. 3. Yatirim, mum yakma programi (recine icin 730 C'ye kadar kademeli), 14K standart alasim vakum dokum ~1060-1090 C metal, flaska ~600 C.
  4. 4. Yolluk kesimi (alt kol arkasi), tesviye: ince egeler ve 600-1200 zimpara; ray kalinligi kumpasla 0.9 +/- 0.05, genislik 1.0 +/- 0.05 kontrol.
  5. 5. Pencere uclarini ve D2.0 deligi 0.6 mm pin-gauge ile kontrol; perde (flash) varsa tel testere ile temizle.
  6. 6. Elmas tiras (on yuz ray fasetleri) - son metal kaldirma islemi; tiras sonrasi ray kalinligi >=0.85.
  7. 7. Kulp ici cila (zincir surtunmesi), elde cila; tamburda kisa (20 dk) porselen/celik bilye, elmas tiras kenarlari korunur.
  8. 8. QC: tartim (uc 1.81 g +/- %5), uc yaricaplari >=0.4 (parmakla takilma testi), kulp kesiti 1.0 x 1.6 kontrol, zincire takma.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; Zn serbest), vakum dokum. Bitmis uc altini 1.808 g x 1.15 = 2.08 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Tas: yok.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm, 18in toplam (16in + 2in uzatma) = 1.902 g.
  • Bulgular: 14K istakoz kopca ~9mm 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 x 14K atlama halkasi 0.060 g, 14K uzatma etiketi 0.046 g.

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Ince rayda eksik dolum / soguk birlesme (0.9 mm rayin uzak kol uclari)Model kalinligi 1.2, uc besleme kanali, vakum dokum; ray 0.85 ust sinirdan degil 0.9 bitmisten kuruldu.
Pencere uclarinda yatirim perdesi / kor delik (0.6 alti aciklik)Her pencere 0.6 mm genislige inince r0.3 ile kapatildi; merkez yildiz delik yerine D2.0 yuvarlak delik.
Uzun alt kolun egilmesi/takilmasi (kumas)Alt kola gobekten uca orta kaburga eklendi (iki 10.25 mm kenari ucgenler); tum uclar r>=0.5 yuvarlak.
Elmas tirasin rayi 0.8 alti inceltmesiOn yuze +0.1 ek model payi; tiras sonrasi kalinlik QC >=0.85.

Etsy metni

Başlık 77/140

14K Gold Comet Pendant Necklace, Four Lab Grown Sapphires, Shooting Star Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, comet necklace, shooting star, lab grown sapphire, celestial jewelry, star pendant, figaro chain, wish necklace, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold pendant, astronomy gift, new year gift

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold figaro chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

A comet in gold: a domed head with a lab-grown white sapphire and two tail rails that sweep away from it, three more sapphires running down the main rail. A shooting-star wish for Christmas and every day after.

THE PIECE
About 31 mm long. The domed head is 6.0 mm across; the main tail rail is 26 mm long and narrows from 1.6 mm to 1.0 mm, the second rail is 18 mm, joined by three short cross bars. Rail faces are diamond-cut, the head is polished, every tip is rounded. Because the head is the heaviest part, the pendant hangs with the tail turned about 20 degrees off vertical.

GOLD WEIGHT
4.10 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.12 g in total with the stones.

STONES
Four round lab-grown white sapphires, all flush set: one 2.0 mm in the head, one 1.8 mm and two 1.5 mm along the main rail, 0.09 ct in total. Each sits level with the gold over a small hole that lets light and cleaning water through. Lab-grown sapphire has the hardness of mined sapphire (Mohs 9).

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.5 mm 14k figaro chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Toplam ~31 mm capraz (bas D6.0 + kuyruk 26 mm). Bas: D6.0, kenar 1.0, merkez 1.8 (kure kapak). Ana kuyruk rayi 26 mm, genislik 1.6->1.0, kalinlik 1.0. Ikinci ray 18 x 1.0 x 1.0. 3 capraz baglanti 0.8 gen x 1.0, raylar arasi 1.8. Tas pedleri: 1.8 mm tas icin D2.8 x 1.7; 1.5 mm taslar icin D2.4 x 1.5. Kuyruk ucu r0.5. Kulp kesit 1.0 x 1.6 (bas arkasi ust-yan).

Tek parca 14K dokum: bas, iki ray, 3 baglanti, 3 ped ve kulp ayni mumdan; lehim yok. Ray boyunca kalinlik 1.0, yalniz tas noktalarinda KANIT flush_seat_rule'a gore yerel pedler (1.5 mm tas: 1.5, 1.8 mm tas: 1.7, 2.0 mm tas: 1.8 yerel kalinlik). Her tasin altinda boydan boya pilot delik (D0.9 / D1.0). Taslar en son, soguk, flush/gypsy.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis olcu + 0.2 bitirme payi (kuyruk elmas tiras yuzune +0.1). Tas pedleri ve D0.9/D1.0 pilot delikleri modelde.
  2. 2. Recine baski; besleme bas arkasindan (en kalin kesit) + ana ray ortasindan yardimci besleme.
  3. 3. Yatirim, yakma, 14K vakum dokum.
  4. 4. Yolluk kesimi, tesviye; ray kalinligi 1.0 +/- 0.05, ped kalinliklari 1.5 / 1.7 / 1.8 kumpasla.
  5. 5. Bas kubbesi on cila, kuyruk raylarina elmas tiras.
  6. 6. Tas yuvasi: pilot deligi teyit, yuva frezesi (hart bur) ile rondis seviyesine; tas tablasi yuzeyle es ya da 0.05 asagida.
  7. 7. Tas oturtma (soguk): tasi yerlestir, cevre metali itici/cekicle ~0.02-0.05 mm rondis uzerine bindir, parlatici (burnisher) ile kapat. Her tas icin 10x lupla salinim testi.
  8. 8. Son cila (tas cevresi elde), QC: tartim (uc 1.55 g +/- %5), arkadan culet tasmasi yok (tirnakla), asilis acisi testi zincirde.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; Zn serbest), vakum dokum. Bitmis uc 1.552 g x 1.15 = 1.79 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Taslar: 1 x 2.0 mm (0.034 ct) + 1 x 1.8 mm (0.025 ct) + 2 x 1.5 mm (0.014 ct) lab grown white sapphire = 0.087 ct.
  • Zincir: 14K solid figaro 1.5 mm, 18in = 2.195 g.
  • Bulgular: 14K istakoz ~9mm 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Culet arkadan tasar / yuva dibi delinir (orijinal 0.8 mm rayda 1.5 mm tas)Yerel kalinlik KANIT'a gore: 1.5/1.7/1.8 mm; yuva altinda planli pilot delik (0.55 mm kalan derinlik, D0.9 -> oran 0.6).
Ince kuyrugun dokumde eksik dolumu veya cilada egilmesiRay 1.0 kalinlik, 3 capraz baglanti (en uzun serbest aciklik ~6 mm), ikinci besleme kanali; cila elde, tamburda degil.
Tas gevsemesi (darbe/surtunme)Yanal duvar 0.45-0.50 (KANIT Stuller tablosu), 0.02-0.05 mm bindirme, taslar tum metal islerinden sonra takilir.
Asimetrik parcanin zincirde ters donmesiKulp bas arkasinda ust-yan konumda, bas en agir kesit; agirlik merkezi kulbun altinda kalir, zincirde test edilir.

Başlık 90/140

14K Gold Crescent Moon Necklace, Evil Eye Enamel, Lab Grown Blue Sapphire, Protection Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, crescent moon, evil eye necklace, nazar pendant, enamel necklace, vitreous enamel, lab grown sapphire, protection amulet, moon necklace, christmas gift, gift for her, talisman jewelry, solid gold pendant

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown blue sapphire, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

An evil eye in navy and white glass enamel, held by a gold crescent that wraps its lower half, with a pale blue lab-grown sapphire at each tip. A protection gift for Christmas that is worn all year.

THE PIECE
15.3 mm across the crescent tips and 11.6 mm tall. The eye disc is 9.2 mm across, the crescent is polished gold and joined to the disc along its inner edge. The bail is hidden behind the disc.

GOLD WEIGHT
4.01 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.06 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque, in navy blue and white: three fields divided by 0.7 mm gold rings, level with the gold.

STONES
Two 1.5 mm round lab-grown sapphires in a pale ice blue, one in a round pad at each crescent tip, flush set after the last firing.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Disk D9.2 x 1.35 (hucre 0.55 + taban 0.80). Hucreler: gozbebegi D1.8; beyaz halka r1.6-2.4 (0.8 gen); lacivert halka r3.1-3.9 (0.8 gen); hucre arasi ve cevre altin duvar 0.7. Hilal: dis daire R6.0 (merkez y=-1.0), ic daire R5.6 (merkez y=+1.8), t=1.0; diskle alt 130 derecelik yay boyunca kaynasik (0.8 bindirme); hilal-disk araligi uclarda >=0.6, daha darsa kati dolgu. Boynuz uclari D2.4 x 1.5 ped (merkez +/-6.45, 0.4). Boyun min kesit 1.0 x 1.0. Toplam 15.3 x 11.6 mm + arka kulp.

Tek parca 14K cinkosuz alasim dokum: disk, hilal, iki ped, hucre duvarlari ve arka kulp ayni mumdan; lehim hic yok. Hucreler dokumde birakilir (oyma degil), tabanlar filetolu (r0.15). Disk arkasi ciplak altin (karsi-mine gerekmez: taban 0.80, L2). Mine 3 pisirim, taslar tum pisirimlerden sonra soguk.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis olcu + 0.2 bitirme payi; hucre derinligi 0.55 (+0.05 tesviye payi), duvarlar 0.7 net (model 0.75), taban filetosu r0.15.
  2. 2. Recine baski, besleme disk alt-arkasindan (en kalin kesit), boynuzlara yardimci kanal.
  3. 3. Yatirim + yakma; CINKOSUZ 14K alasimla vakum dokum. Dokum sonrasi gozeneklilik kontrolu (10x lup, hucre tabanlari); gozenekli parca HURDA (mine pinhole verir).
  4. 4. Tesviye ve on cila (hilal, pedler); hucre ici: ince cam fircayla temizle, taban kalinligi 0.80 kumpas/derinlik saati ile.
  5. 5. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding): 3-4 dongu ~593 C kiraz kirmizisi tav + %10 H2SO4 asit; damitik su, cam firca, yagsiz.
  6. 6. Mine dolumu: 80 mesh yikanmis opak beyaz ve lacivert, islak dolum; kurut (firin ustu 2-3 dk).
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 780 C, 90 sn, paslanmaz sehpa (trivet), kalibre pirometre.
  8. 8. Pisirim 2: ikinci dolum, 780 C, 90 sn (yuzeyden hafif tasma).
  9. 9. Tasla zimpara (alundum cubuk + su) mine ve altin duvarlar es seviye; temizle.
  10. 10. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 60 sn parlatma pisirimi. Toplam 3 pisirim.
  11. 11. Asitleme YOK (mine korunur); sodyum bikarbonat + su ile notr temizlik.
  12. 12. Tas yuvalari (pedlerde): pilot delik teyidi, hart bur; mine Plasti-tac/bant ile maskelenir.
  13. 13. Tas oturtma soguk; itme kuvveti diskin tersine (disaridan iceri degil); mineye 1.45 mm mesafe.
  14. 14. Pisirim sonrasi lazer: YOK (kulp entegre dokum).
  15. 15. Cila: yalniz altin yuzeyler, elde, mineye dokunmadan; QC: pinhole/catlak lup 10x, tartim (uc 1.75 g +/- %5), boynuz uc kontrolu.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi ve solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Bitmis uc 1.750 g x 1.15 = 2.01 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak lacivert ~75 mg + opak beyaz ~40 mg (pisirilmis mine 42 mg; dolum/tas kaybi icin ~2.5x).
  • Taslar: 2 x 1.5 mm lab grown blue sapphire = 0.0285 ct.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm 18in = 1.902 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Kabarcik / igne deligi (alasimdaki Zn veya dokum gozenegi)Zn=0 sertifikali alasim, vakum dokum, gozenekli dokum hurdaya; 3-4 dongu depletion gilding.
Beyaz minenin 14K uzerinde krem/sariya donmesi (Cu oksit)Opak beyaz, yuzey zenginlestirme, pilot kuponda renk onayi; olmazsa beyaz halka yerine ciplak altin halka (2 renk -> 1 renk) B plani.
Ince hilal (1.0) veya boynuz boynunun firinda sarkmasi (14K solidus payi dar)Pisirim <=780 C, kisa sure, kalibre pirometre; parca hilal alttan desteklenecek sekilde sehpada; boyun min kesit 1.0 x 1.0.
Tas oturtmada itme kuvvetiyle mine catlamasiTaslar boynuz pedinde, mine kenarina 1.45 mm; KANIT 0.6-0.8 onerisinin ustunde; itme diskten disari yonde.
Diskin hilalden kopmasi (orijinalde tek tegetsel temas)Disk ve hilal 130 derecelik yay boyunca 0.8 mm bindirmeli tek dokum.

Etsy metni

Başlık 87/140

14K Gold Hamsa Hand Necklace, Openwork Pendant, Lab Grown Sapphire Eye, Protection Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, hamsa necklace, hamsa hand, openwork pendant, lab grown sapphire, protection amulet, talisman jewelry, hand of fatima, christmas gift, gift for her, cable chain necklace, solid gold pendant, good luck gift

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown white sapphire, lab grown blue sapphire, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

A hamsa drawn as an open gold frame, with an almond eye across the palm and a pale blue lab-grown sapphire as its pupil. A protection gift for Christmas and every day after.

THE PIECE
14 mm wide and 18 mm tall. A 1.0 mm rail outlines three fingers and two outward-curving thumbs; the palm is a solid oval plate with an 8.0 by 4.4 mm eye opening crossed by a thin gold bar. The rail is diamond-cut, the palm polished. The bail sits behind the middle finger.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.98 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.99 g in total with the stones.

STONES
Three 1.5 mm round lab-grown sapphires, flush set: a pale ice-blue sapphire as the pupil and a white sapphire in each thumb tip, 0.04 ct in total. Mohs 9.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

El 14.0 x 18.0 mm; dis hat rayi 1.0 gen x 0.9 kal (model 1.2 x 1.2), cevre ~72 mm. Avuc plakasi elips 9.4 x 7.6 x 1.0. Badem goz acikligi 8.0 x 4.4; goz cizgisi kopru 0.7 gen x 1.0; gozbebegi gobegi D2.4 x 1.5. Badem acikligi kopru ve gobekle 4 parcaya bolunur; her biri 0.6 mm genislige indigi yerde r0.3 ile kapanir (acik uzunluk ~2.0, max yukseklik 1.7). Basparmak uc pedleri D2.4 x 1.5. Parmak ici bosluklar >=0.8. Kulp 1.0 x 1.6.

Tek parca 14K dokum; ray, avuc, kopru, gobek, pedler, kulp ayni mumdan; lehim yok, mine yok. Tum delikler mumdan. Taslar en son, soguk.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2 (ray on yuzu elmas tiras +0.1); badem acikliklari 0.6'da r0.3 ile kapatilir; pedler 1.5.
  2. 2. Recine baski, besleme bilek kenari arkasindan + avuc arkasindan.
  3. 3. Yatirim, yakma, 14K vakum dokum.
  4. 4. Yolluk kesimi, tesviye; acikliklari 0.6 pin-gauge ile; ray 0.9 +/- 0.05.
  5. 5. Ray yuzlerine elmas tiras; avuc on cila.
  6. 6. Tas yuvalari: gozbebeginde kopru arkadan ahsap/recine blokla desteklenir, pilot delik + hart bur.
  7. 7. Tas oturtma soguk (3 tas), 10x lupla salinim testi.
  8. 8. Cila elde; QC tartim (uc 1.65 g +/- %5), parmak uclari r>=0.4, culet arkadan tasmiyor.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; Zn serbest), vakum dokum. Bitmis uc 1.647 g x 1.15 = 1.89 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Taslar: 1 x 1.5 mm lab blue sapphire + 2 x 1.5 mm lab white sapphire = 0.0428 ct.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm 18in = 1.902 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.
