Etsy metni

Başlık 86/140

14K Gold Icicle Pendant Necklace, Lab Grown Blue Sapphire, Winter Jewelry Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, icicle necklace, icicle pendant, winter jewelry, lab grown sapphire, blue sapphire, ice jewelry, drop pendant, christmas gift, gift for her, cable chain necklace, minimalist pendant, new year gift

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown blue sapphire, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

An icicle in 14k gold, ribbed and tapering to a rounded tip, with a pale blue lab-grown sapphire under its faceted collar. A winter piece for Christmas that keeps going through January and beyond.

THE PIECE
23 mm long, 4.6 mm across the faceted collar, narrowing to a rounded 0.8 mm tip. Four uneven ribs run down the upper half. The upper body is hollow-formed to keep the weight wearable, with two small drain holes on the back; the lower part is solid. The bail sits behind the collar.

GOLD WEIGHT
4.15 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.15 g in total with the stones.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab-grown sapphire in a pale ice blue, flush set in a small raised pad. Mohs 9.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Boy 23 mm (yaka ustu - uc), govde ust D4.2 -> uc D0.8 (r0.4 yarim kure). Yaka D4.6 x 1.8 kati, fasetli. Bosluk z=1.8..15.0, duvar 0.80 sabit (ic koni dis yuzeyle AYNI yari-aci); alttaki 8 mm kati. 2 tahliye deligi D1.6 arka yuzde (z=3 kulp altinda, z=12 kaburga ucunda). 4 kaburga 0.6 gen x 0.4 yuk x 12 mm. On tas pedi D2.4, 0.7 cikinti, z=0.6-3.0 (ust yarisi kati yakaya basar). Kulp 1.0 x 1.6. Toplam boy kulpla ~27 mm.

Tek parca 14K hollow dokum: 3D baski oyuk recine model, ic cekirdek yatirimi 3 noktadan baglanir (2 tahliye deligi + tas yuvasi delik). Dikis yok, lehim yok, mine yok. Tas yuvasi deligi bosluga acilir (tasin altinda delik sarti saglanir). 'Solid' kelimesi baslik/etiket/aciklamada GECMEZ: 'hollow-formed 14K gold' + gram beyan.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: dis yuzey + ic koni ayni yari-aci (duvar 0.80 normal; model 1.0); kati yaka 1.8, kati uc 8 mm; 2 x D1.6 tahliye + D0.9 tas deligi cekirdek baglantisi.
  2. 2. Oyuk recine baski (ic yuzey destek yok, drenaj delikleri acik), recineyi iceriden IPA ile yika, UV sertlestir.
  3. 3. Yatirim vakum altinda (cekirdegin tam dolmasi icin 2 dk vakum), yakma, 14K vakum dokum.
  4. 4. Yatirimi su jeti ile tahliye deliklerinden temizle; deliklerin D1.6 acikligini pin-gauge ile dogrula; ici ultrasonik + su ile durula, firinda kurut (asit/su hapsi olmasin).
  5. 5. Duvar kalinligi kontrolu: ultrasonik kalinlik olcer ya da isik arkasi 3 noktada (z=4, 9, 14); <0.75 ise HURDA.
  6. 6. Kaburga tepelerine elmas tiras, govde cila (elde; tamburda cokme riskine karsi kisa ve hafif).
  7. 7. Tas yuvasi: ped arkasi kati yakaya yaslanir; parca sekilli recine/ahsap destekte; hart bur ile yuva; delik bosluga acik.
  8. 8. Tas oturtma soguk; QC tartim (uc 1.80 g +/- %5), uc r0.4, tahliye delikleri acik.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; Zn serbest), vakum dokum. Bitmis uc 1.800 g x 1.15 = 2.07 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Tas: 1 x 1.5 mm lab grown blue sapphire = 0.0143 ct.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm 18in = 1.902 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Cekirdek kaymasi -> duvar 0.8 altina iner (orijinalde farkli koni acilariyla 0.69'a kadar inceliyordu)Ic koni dis yuzeyle ayni yari-aci (duvar z=2..14 boyunca 0.80 hesapla dogrulandi); cekirdek 3 noktadan bagli; dokum sonrasi kalinlik olcumu, <0.75 hurda.
Ic bosluga yatirim/asit/su hapsi2 x D1.6 tahliye + D0.9 tas deligi; su jeti, ultrasonik, notrlestirme ve firinda kurutma.
Cepte ezilme / gocmeKonik kabuk, 0.8 duvar, alttaki 8 mm kati uc, ustte 1.8 kati yaka.
Tas yuvasi acarken bosluga delip gecme / oturtmada gocmeHost 1.5 (0.7 ped + 0.8 duvar), delik planli olarak bosluga acilir; pedin ust yarisi kati yakaya basar; parca destek uzerinde oturtulur.

Window Frost Enamel Bar

14K Gold Ice Blue Enamel Bar Necklace, Frost Crystal Pendant, Winter Gift for Her

Etsy metni

Başlık 81/140

14K Gold Ice Blue Enamel Bar Necklace, Frost Crystal Pendant, Winter Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, enamel necklace, bar necklace, ice blue enamel, vitreous enamel, frost necklace, winter jewelry, ice crystal, christmas gift, gift for her, cable chain necklace, solid gold pendant, modern pendant

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

A slim gold bar filled with ice-blue glass enamel and crossed by fine gold lines that branch the way frost grows on a window. A winter gift for Christmas with nothing seasonal to put away in January.

THE PIECE
6.5 by 17 mm with rounded corners, 1.4 mm thick. Three gold lines run out from a small round node to the frame, with short side lines branching at 60 degrees, so the blue is split into three fields. A 0.7 mm gold border frames the bar. The bail sits at the top back.

GOLD WEIGHT
4.00 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.08 g in total with the enamel.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with the gold lines.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Plaka 6.5 x 17.0 x 1.40 (kose r1.5); cevre altin cerceve 0.7; ic alan 79.0 mm2. Dendrit: cekirdek sol-alt kosede, 3 ana eksen yalniz 3 altigen yonde (0, 60, 120 derece; ortak eksen yok, simetri yok), ana eksenlerin 3'u de cerceveye ulasir; 4 ikincil dal 1.5 mm, 60 derece, tek tarafli, uclari r0.35 serbest (tam yukseklikte duvar, kabartma degil). Toplam dendrit merkez-hatti ~30 mm, duvar 0.7. 5 hucre, en dar hucre genisligi 0.9. Mine 58 mm2 x 0.55 derin; taban 0.85.

Tek parca 14K cinkosuz alasim dokum; hucreler dokumde. Lehim yok, tas yok. Arka yuz ciplak altin (taban 0.85 >= 0.8: karsi-mine gerekmez). Mine duz, parlatma pisirimiyle biter (kubbe kacisi yok).

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: plaka 1.40 bitmis (model 1.60), dendrit duvarlari 0.7 net (model 0.75), hucre koseleri r0.2, ikincil dal uclari r0.35.
  2. 2. Recine baski; plaka dik, besleme alt kenar arkasindan (iki kanal).
  3. 3. Yatirim, yakma, CINKOSUZ 14K vakum dokum; dokum gozenegi kontrolu (hucre tabani 10x lup), gozenekli = hurda.
  4. 4. Tesviye, arka yuz duzleme (1.40 +/- 0.05), on cila cerceve.
  5. 5. Depletion gilding 3-4 dongu (593 C + %10 H2SO4).
  6. 6. Opak buz mavisi islak dolum, kurutma.
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 780 C, 90 sn; plaka duz mika/elek uzerinde (sarkma yok).
  8. 8. Pisirim 2: 780 C, 90 sn.
  9. 9. Alundum/elmas cubukla duzleme, dendrit duvarlari ortaya cikar.
  10. 10. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 60 sn parlatma.
  11. 11. Asit yok; notr temizlik. Tas yok. Pisirim sonrasi lazer yok (kulp entegre).
  12. 12. Cila yalniz cerceve kenari ve arka; QC: pinhole/catlak, tartim (uc 1.77 g +/- %5).

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi ve solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Bitmis uc 1.767 g x 1.15 = 2.03 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak buz mavisi ~200 mg (pisirilmis 80 mg x ~2.5).
  • Tas: yok.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm 18in = 1.902 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor

Uzun dar kanalda mine catlamasi5 genis duzensiz hucre, min 0.9 genislik, her hucre altin ile cevrili, koseler r0.2.
Ince plakanin firinda egrilmesi1.40 kalinlik, duz destek, <=780 C kisa pisirim, 3 pisirim (<=4).

14k gold necklace, angel wing, guardian angel, wing necklace, memorial necklace, lab grown sapphire, remembrance gift, sympathy gift, christmas gift, gift for her, rope chain necklace, solid gold pendant, angel jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold rope chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

A single angel wing in 14k gold, a row of rounded feathers above five long ones, with one lab-grown sapphire at the shoulder. A guardian-angel gift for Christmas, and a remembrance piece for any day.

THE PIECE
9 mm wide and 14.5 mm tall, 0.9 mm thick. Five long feathers are separated by narrow pierced slits and meet along a closed lower edge, so nothing catches. Feather faces are diamond-cut. The bail sits at the top centre of the wing.

GOLD WEIGHT
4.14 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.14 g in total with the stones.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphire, flush set at the inner upper corner. Mohs 9.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k diamond-cut rope chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Kanat 9.0 x 16.0 x 0.9 (model 1.2: +0.2 bitirme +0.1 elmas tiras). Ortu tuyu bandi 9 x 5 (3 yuvarlak tarak). 5 birincil tuy 1.4 gen, boylar 9.5/9.0/8.5/7.5/6.5, aralarinda 0.6 yarik; yariklar arka kenara 1.5 mm kala biter (kapali kenar, serbest konsol yok). Uc tarak r0.7. Omuz tas pedi D2.4 x 1.5. Kulp 1.0 x 1.6.

Tek parca 14K dokum, lehim yok, mine yok. Yariklar mumdan. Tas en son soguk.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: plaka 0.9 bitmis + 0.3 (bitirme + on yuz elmas tiras); yariklar 0.6, uclari r0.3; ped 1.5.
  2. 2. Recine baski, besleme omuz arkasindan + uzun tuy ucundan yardimci.
  3. 3. Yatirim, yakma, 14K vakum dokum.
  4. 4. Tesviye; yarik genisligi 0.6 pin-gauge; plaka 0.9 +/- 0.05.
  5. 5. Tuy yuzlerine elmas tiras (yarik kenarlari keskin kalir, uc taraklar yuvarlak).
  6. 6. Tas yuvasi (hart bur), tas oturtma soguk.
  7. 7. Cila elde (ince plakayi destekleyerek), QC tartim (uc 1.29 g +/- %5).

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; Zn serbest), vakum dokum. Bitmis uc 1.290 g x 1.15 = 1.48 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Tas: 1 x 1.5 mm lab grown white sapphire = 0.0143 ct.
  • Zincir: 14K solid diamond-cut rope 1.0 mm 18in = 2.451 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

14K Gold Snaffle Bit Necklace, Lab Grown Sapphires, Equestrian Jewelry, Horse Lover Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, snaffle bit, equestrian jewelry, horse lover gift, lab grown sapphire, riding jewelry, equestrian gift, derby jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, cable chain necklace, solid gold necklace, link necklace

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

A snaffle bit in 14k gold: two round rings joined by a jointed mouthpiece, worn across the front of the chain, with a lab-grown sapphire on each ring. An equestrian gift for Christmas and the riding season.

THE PIECE
About 33 mm wide. Two 9.0 mm rings in 1.3 mm round wire are joined by a short jointed mouthpiece whose inner eyes interlock at the centre. The chain runs through both rings, so there is no bail.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.70 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.71 g in total with the stones.

STONES
Two 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, one flush set on the front of each ring. Mohs 9.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Yanak halkasi dis D9.0, tel D1.3 (ic D6.4). Agizlik yarisi 6.5 mm (goz merkezleri arasi), D1.3->1.0. Orta gozler R1.45 tel D1.1 (ic D1.8; gecen tel 1.1 -> bosluk 0.7). Dis gozler R1.6 tel D1.1 (ic D2.1; halka teli 1.3 -> bosluk 0.8). Toplam genislik ~33 mm, yukseklik 9 mm. Tas pedleri halka 12 yonu on yuz D2.4 x 1.5. Kaynaklar 6 yonu (alt).

Montajli 4 dokum (2 halka acik dokulur, 1 agizlik yarisi kapali orta gozlu, 1 yarisi ACIK orta gozlu; dis gozler kapali). Sira: dis gozlere halkalar gecirilir, A yarisinin kapali orta gozune B'nin acik gozu takilir ve lazerle kapatilir (kaynak goz ucunda, egilme yukunde degil); iki halka 6 yonunde lazerle kapatilir. Toplam 3 lazer kaynagi, lehim yok (mine yok; L3 hamlac yasagi uygulanmasa da lazer: tavlanma ve gorunur dikis yok). Pedler dokunulmamis halka kesitinde, kaynaklardan 180 derece uzakta.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: 4 parca, bitmis + 0.2; acik halka ve acik goz uclarinda 0.3 mm kaynak hazirlik pahi; bosluklar 0.7/0.8.
  2. 2. Recine baski, 14K vakum dokum (4 parca ayni agac).
  3. 3. Her parca acikken ayri tesviye ve on cila (eklem yuzeyleri dahil); agizliklara elmas tiras.
  4. 4. Montaj 1: A yarisinin kapali gozune B'nin acik gozu takilir, uclar kapatilir, LAZER kaynak (dusuk guc, 2 atis her yuz), dressing, 10x lup.
  5. 5. Montaj 2: dis gozlere acik halkalar gecirilir, halka uclari 6 yonunde kapatilir, LAZER kaynak, kaynak dikisi elle tesviye.
  6. 6. Eklem serbestligi testi (baglanma yok), kaynak cekme testi (elde 2 kg).
  7. 7. Tas yuvalari (12 yonu, kaynaklardan uzak), soguk oturtma.
  8. 8. Son cila (kaplama/rodaj yok), zincir halkalardan gecirilir; QC tartim (bit 1.56 g +/- %5).

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; Zn serbest), vakum dokum. Bitmis bit 1.556 g x 1.15 = 1.79 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Taslar: 2 x 1.5 mm lab grown white sapphire = 0.0285 ct.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm 18in = 1.902 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g. Lazer kaynak teli gerekmez (ana metal eritme).

Stirrup Slider Pendant

14K Gold Stirrup Necklace, Jade Green Enamel Slider Pendant, Equestrian Gift for Her

Kalıcı atlı kategori; derin yeşil yarış rengi olarak okunur, Noel envanteri değil.

Etsy metni

Başlık 84/140

14K Gold Stirrup Necklace, Jade Green Enamel Slider Pendant, Equestrian Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, stirrup necklace, equestrian jewelry, enamel necklace, green enamel, vitreous enamel, horse lover gift, slider pendant, riding jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold pendant, derby jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

A riding stirrup in 14k gold with a row of jade-green glass enamel along its tread. It slides on the chain with no bail. An equestrian gift for Christmas that belongs to every season.

THE PIECE
13 mm wide and 16 mm tall. A 1.6 mm rail forms the arched stirrup over a flat 12 mm base bar; five small enamel cells sit in a row on the bar, divided by fine gold ribs. A slot in the top bar takes the chain.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.89 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.90 g in total with the enamel.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade green, set just below the gold edges.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.2 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Dis 13 x 16 mm. Kemer rayi 1.6 gen x 1.2 kal, merkez-hat yari elips a=5.7 b=12.5, uzunluk 29.6 mm (Ramanujan). Ust cubuk 6.0 x 3.6 x 1.4, yarik 4.0 x 1.6 (yarik cevresinde her yonde 1.0 duvar), yarik kenarlari r0.4. Basamak 12.0 x 2.6 x 1.5: kenar raylari 0.7, uc duvarlar 0.7, mine paneli 10.6 x 1.2 raylardan 0.1 asagida; 5 hucre 1.56 x 1.2 x 0.55, 4 kaburga 0.7; taban 0.85.

Tek parca 14K cinkosuz alasim dokum; kulp yok, lehim yok, tas yok. Hucreler dokumde. Arka ciplak altin (taban 0.85). Mine duz ve 0.1 cokertilmis panelde.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; panel 0.1 cokertme, hucre koseleri r0.2, yarik kenarlari r0.4.
  2. 2. Recine baski, besleme basamak arkasindan (en kalin) + ust cubuktan.
  3. 3. Yatirim, yakma, CINKOSUZ 14K vakum dokum; hucre tabani gozenek kontrolu.
  4. 4. Tesviye; yarik ici cila (zincir yatagi).
  5. 5. Depletion gilding 3-4 dongu (593 C + %10 H2SO4).
  6. 6. Derin yesil opak islak dolum.
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 780 C, 90 sn; parca basamak ve ust cubuktan desteklenir (kemer sarkmasin).
  8. 8. Pisirim 2: 780 C, 75 sn.
  9. 9. 1.0 mm elmas cubukla panel ici duzleme (kenar raylarina dokunmadan).
  10. 10. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 60 sn parlatma. Asit yok.
  11. 11. Tas yok, lazer yok. Cila yalniz altin yuzeyler; QC: tartim (uc 1.47 g +/- %5), mine raylardan asagida (cetvel + lup).

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi ve solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Bitmis uc 1.468 g x 1.15 = 1.69 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak derin yesil ~35 mg (pisirilmis 13 mg x ~2.5).
  • Tas: yok.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.2 mm 18in = 2.236 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

Cardinal Pendant

14K Gold Cardinal Necklace, Berry Enamel Bird Pendant, Memorial Keepsake, Sympathy Gift

Etsy metni

Başlık 87/140

14K Gold Cardinal Necklace, Berry Enamel Bird Pendant, Memorial Keepsake, Sympathy Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold necklace, cardinal necklace, cardinal jewelry, memorial necklace, enamel necklace, berry enamel, vitreous enamel, bird necklace, sympathy gift, christmas gift, gift for her, remembrance gift, solid gold pendant

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold cable chain, 14k gold lobster clasp

Açıklama

A cardinal in profile, its breast, wing and tail in deep berry glass enamel and its crest and face in polished gold. A keepsake many people give when they remember someone at Christmas.

THE PIECE
11 mm wide and 15 mm tall, 1.35 mm thick. The enamel is a dark blackberry red, divided into three fields by fine gold lines that mark the wing and tail. The eye is a small round opening through the gold. The bail is hidden behind the back.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.82 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.89 g in total with the enamel.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry, cadmium-free, level with the gold.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Siluet 11 x 15 x 1.35 (doluluk 0.58 -> 95.7 mm2). 3 hucre: gogus/govde 22 mm2, kanat 15 mm2, kuyruk 11 mm2; derinlik 0.55, en dar yer 1.2, duvar ve cevre 0.7, taban 0.80. Yuz maskesi/gaga/tepe kenari ciplak altin; goz D0.8 delik (1.35/0.8 = 1.69). Tepe ucu r0.5. Kulp 1.0 x 1.6 sirt arkasi.

Tek parca 14K cinkosuz alasim dokum, hucreler dokumde; lehim yok, tas yok. Arka ciplak altin (taban 0.80). Bogurtlen tek renk; tum pisirimler bant alt ucunda (760 C).

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; hucre koseleri r0.2; goz D0.8 delik; tepe ucu r0.5.
  2. 2. Recine baski, besleme sirt arkasindan.
  3. 3. Yatirim, yakma, CINKOSUZ 14K vakum dokum; gozenek kontrolu.
  4. 4. Tesviye, maske/gaga on cila, goz deligi 0.8 pin-gauge.
  5. 5. Depletion gilding 3-4 dongu (593 C + %10 H2SO4).
  6. 6. Opak derin bogurtlen (kadmiyumsuz secilmeli) islak dolum.
  7. 7. Pisirim 1: 760 C, 90 sn.
  8. 8. Pisirim 2: 760 C, 75 sn.
  9. 9. Tasla duzleme.
  10. 10. Pisirim 3: 760 C, 60 sn parlatma. Asit yok.
  11. 11. Tas yok, lazer yok; cila yalniz altin; QC: renk kuponla karsilastir (kahverengiye kayma yok), tartim (uc 1.53 g +/- %5).

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi ve solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Bitmis uc 1.532 g x 1.15 = 1.76 g dokum metali.
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz, kadmiyumsuz opak derin bogurtlen ~165 mg (pisirilmis 66 mg x ~2.5).
  • Tas: yok.
  • Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm 18in = 1.902 g.
  • Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.

Buyuk tek hucrede catlama (orijinal 45 mm2 tek govde hucresi)Kanat ve kuyruk cizgileriyle 3 hucreye bolundu (max 22 mm2), her hucre 0.7 altinla cevrili.
Kenar cercevesinin ayni anda yapisal + mine duvari olmasi (orijinal 0.5)Cevre 0.7, plaka 1.35; yuz maskesi bolgesi kati altin olarak siluete rijitlik verir.
Kadmiyum iceren kirmizi mine (ABD eyalet Pb/Cd sinirlari)Kadmiyumsuz bogurtlen tedarik + SDS; uygun degilse renk degisikligi kararina kadar seri yok.

North Star Stud

14K Gold North Star Stud Earrings, Lab Grown White Sapphire, Eight-Point Starburst

14K sarı altın1.55 g altın2 x 2,0 mm lab beyaz safir

Yildiz 12 ay satan form; ad ve baslik 'North Star' oldugu icin 26 Aralik'tan sonra hicbir kelime degismez, yalniz 'bethlehem star' etiketi 'star earrings' ile degisir.

Etsy metni

Başlık 82/140

14K Gold North Star Stud Earrings, Lab Grown White Sapphire, Eight-Point Starburst

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, gold stud earrings, north star earrings, star stud earrings, lab grown sapphire, celestial jewelry, starburst studs, bethlehem star, christmas gift, gift for her, minimalist studs, solid gold studs, everyday earrings

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

An eight-pointed star in 14k gold, with a flush-set lab-grown white sapphire at the center of each stud. Bright faceted ridges run along every point, so the pair catches light at a small size, an easy Christmas gift that is worn all year.

THE PIECE
Each stud is an eight-pointed star: four long points 11.4 mm tip to tip and four short points 7.6 mm tip to tip. The center boss is 3.4 mm across and 1.8 mm thick. Every point has straight side walls 0.6 mm high and a low two-facet ridge, and ends in a rounded tip 0.8 mm wide. The back is flat polished gold.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.55 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.56 g in total with the stones. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
Two 2.0 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, one per stud, 0.068 ct in total. Each is flush set, table level with the gold, over a small hole that lets light and cleaning water through. The stones are set last, after all polishing.

LENGTH AND FIT
Each star measures 11.4 mm across the long points. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back. The post sits just above the center, so the star stays upright on the lobe.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each star is cast in 14k gold in one piece, then the ridges are cut bright and polished. There is no solder: the post is laser welded into a small socket, so it keeps its hardness. The sapphire is set cold, after the last polish.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Keep lotion out of the small hole behind the stone. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Uzun uc-uca 11.4 mm, kisa uc-uca 7.6 mm (stud <=12). Gobek Ø3.4 x 1.8 mm bitmis (eski Ø3.2). Isin kesiti: yan duvar (flank) bitmis 0.6 mm SABIT (model 0.8) + ustte iki fasetli alcak sirt; kesit alani A = gen. x (sirt + 0.6)/2. Uzun isin L4.0, gen. 1.5 -> 0.8, sirt tepesi 1.5 -> 0.6 (ucta sirt yan duvara iner); kisa isin L2.1, gen. 1.1 -> 0.8, sirt 1.2 -> 0.6. Uclar 0.8 mm gen., r0.4. Isin kokleri toplami 10.4 mm < gobek cevresi 10.68 mm (bindirme yok). Civi soketi Ø0.8 x 0.5, gobek merkezinin 1.25 mm ustu (soket 0.85-1.65 mm, gobek r1.7 icinde; tas deligine 0.40 mm). Civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm. Model +0.2 (sirtta +0.3).

Tek parca dokum 14K sari. Isinlar duz yan duvarli kama kesit + iki fasetli alcak sirt (bicak sirt degil). Yolluk gobek arkasina (en kalin nokta). Gobekte Ø0.9 boydan boya tas deligi dokumde pilot, sonra delinir. Civi: satin alinan sert cekme Stuller 1800, gobek icindeki Ø0.8 x 0.5 sokete LAZER (lehim yok, civi temperini korur). Tas en son, soguk flush. Mine yok, hollow yok, montaj parcasi yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: kapali kati; isin kesiti yan duvar 0.8 (model) + iki fasetli sirt; gobek Ø3.4 + Ø0.9 pilot; arka soket Ø0.8 x 0.5 merkezin 1.25 mm ustunde; model +0.2 (sirt +0.3).
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum 14K sari; yolluk gobek arkasina.
  3. Yolluk kesimi, tesviye; kumpasla isin ucu 0.8 gen. ve yan duvar >=0.6, gobek 1.8 kontrolu.
  4. Faset sirtlarinin elmas tras kesimi + on cila (yan duvar 0.6 altina inmeden).
  5. Civiyi sokete oturt, dusuk guc lazer; burgu testi.
  6. Tas yuvasi: Ø0.9 delik kontrol, Ø2.0 yuva frezesi; lab safiri kumpasla olc.
  7. 2.0 mm lab beyaz safir flush oturtma (itme/burnisher), tabla altin kotunda.
  8. Son cila + ultrasonik (mine yok, guvenli).
  9. QC: cift 1.55 g +-0.05; tas sallanma testi; civi dikligi; arkalik tutusu; uclarda capak yok.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari; renk birligi icin mineli parcalarla AYNI cinkosuz alasim lotu (Otto Frei 846-180 bazli); mine yok, cinko sart degil; dokum metali ~1.06 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Taslar: 2 x 2.0 mm lab-grown beyaz safir yuvarlak brilyant, 0.034 ct/adet = 0.068 ct
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): gobek O3.4 x 1.8: +16.34 mm3 -> +0.4272 g; 4 uzun isin L4.0, w1.5->0.8, sirt t1.5->0.6, yan duvar 0.6 sabit: A=w(t+0.6)/2: +15.60 mm3 -> +0.4078 g; 4 kisa isin L2.1, w1.1->0.8, sirt t1.2->0.6, yan duvar 0.6: +6.05 mm3 -> +0.1581 g; 2.0 tas yuvasi + O0.9 delik: -2.61 mm3 -> -0.0682 g; civi soketi O0.8x0.5 (merkezden 1.25): -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 0.9183 g, ALTIN 1.550 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.200 g)

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Isin ucunda ince yan duvar / eksik dolumYan duvar bitmis 0.6 mm her noktada sabit (model 0.8); bicak sirt kesit yasak; yolluk gobekte, dolum uclara.

Uclarin kiyafete takilmasiTum uclar r0.4.

Hex Icicle Drop

14K Gold Hexagon Icicle Drop Earrings, Faceted Solid Gold Spike, Geometric Winter Dangle

Altigen fasetli sarkit mevsimsiz geometrik form; Ocak'tan sonra 'geometric spike drop' olarak satar, baslikta tarihli kelime yok.

Etsy metni

Başlık 88/140

14K Gold Hexagon Icicle Drop Earrings, Faceted Solid Gold Spike, Geometric Winter Dangle

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, icicle earrings, hexagon earrings, gold drop earrings, spike earrings, faceted gold drop, winter jewelry, geometric earrings, minimalist dangle, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold drops, long gold earrings

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

A six-sided icicle in solid 14k gold, hanging from a small hexagonal post top, with six long polished facets that flash as it moves. It is a clean geometric drop for winter, a natural Christmas gift that keeps working in every season.

THE PIECE
A flat hexagonal top, 3.4 mm across flats and 0.9 mm thick, sits on the lobe. From its lower edge a 1.0 mm gold ring holds the icicle by a small closed loop. The icicle is solid, 10.5 mm long, 2.2 mm across flats at the top and 0.8 mm at the rounded tip. Overall length about 17 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.68 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.68 g in total. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 17 mm from the top of the hexagon to the tip of the icicle, so it hangs just below the lobe and swings freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The hexagon and the icicle are cast in 14k gold, the six facets are flattened and polished by hand, and the ring is closed with a 1.0 mm gold insert laser welded at both ends. There is no solder, and the post is laser welded, so it stays hard.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth; warm water and mild soap are fine. Take the earrings off before sleeping so the icicle does not catch on fabric. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Ust plaka altigen AF3.4 x 0.9 mm, bir duz kenar altta, dar kenar pahi; arka civi pedi Ø1.6 x 0.3 (yerel 1.2; 0.5 soket sonrasi onde 0.7). Plakanin alt kenar ortasinda dokum C-halka: 1.0 kesit, ic Ø1.2, bosluk 1.1 mm (gecen tel 1.0 + 0.1). Sarkit: kati altigen kesik piramit L10.5, AF 2.2 -> 0.8, uc r0.4 kubbe; tepede dokum KAPALI goz 1.0 kesit, ic Ø1.2. Capraz delik yok. Toplam boy ~17 mm (plaka ustunden uca), cividen uca ~15.3 mm (<=30).

Iki dokum parca 14K sari. (A) altigen plaka + arka ped + dokum ACIK C-halka. (B) kati altigen sarkit + tepede dokum kapali goz (eski Ø1.2 capraz delik kaldirildi). Montaj: C-halka B gozune gecirilir; 1.1 mm bosluk 1.0 mm sert cekme 14K tel tapa (1.1 mm boy) ile doldurulur, tapa iki ucundan dolgusuz alin lazeriyle tam nufuz kaynaklanir -> yuk yolu her noktada 1.0 mm kesit (ince dolgu teli YOK). Civi Stuller 1800 pedin Ø0.8 x 0.5 soketine lazer. Mine yok, tas yok, lehim yok, hollow yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: A plaka + ped + C-halka (bosluk 1.1), B sarkit + tepe gozu; model +0.2 mm.
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum; B yollugu sarkitin kalin tepesine (goz yaninda), dolum uca dogru.
  3. Tesviye; 6 fasetin duzlenmesi ve elmas cila; uc r0.4 kubbe; goz ici capak alma.
  4. A pedine civi lazer + burgu testi.
  5. C-halkayi B gozune gecir; 1.0 mm tel tapayi bosluga oturt, iki ucu dolgusuz alin lazeriyle tam nufuz kaynakla; kaynak dikisi 10x; 2 kg cekme testi.
  6. Son cila, ultrasonik.
  7. QC: cift 1.68 g +-0.05; sarkit serbest salinim; uc yuvarlakligi; halka kesiti tapa bolgesinde >=1.0.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari; renk birligi icin mineli parcalarla AYNI cinkosuz alasim lotu (Otto Frei 846-180 bazli); mine yok, cinko sart degil; dokum metali ~1.18 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • 2 x 1.0 mm sert cekme 14K sari tel tapa, 1.1 mm boy (0.864 mm3 = ~11 mg/adet, ~23 mg/cift; C-halka boslugu, iki uctan dolgusuz alin lazeri)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): altigen plaka AF3.4 x 0.9 (pah k=0.95): +8.56 mm3 -> +0.2237 g; arka civi pedi O1.6 x 0.3: +0.60 mm3 -> +0.0158 g; civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; dokum C-halka 1.0 kesit ID1.2, bosluk 1.1 (sahip degeri): +4.20 mm3 -> +0.1098 g; C-halka tapasi 1.0 tel x 1.1: +0.86 mm3 -> +0.0226 g; altigen sarkit kesik piramit AF2.2->0.8, L10.5: +21.95 mm3 -> +0.5736 g; sarkit tepesi dokum kapali goz 1.0 kesit ID1.2: +4.20 mm3 -> +0.1098 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 1.0487 g, ALTIN 1.680 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.070 g)

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
C-halka kapamasinin acilmasi -> sarkitin dusmesiBosluk 1.0 mm tam kesit tel tapayla doldurulur, iki alin kaynagi tam nufuz; her parca 2 kg cekme testi.
Sarkit tepe gozu kokunun kopmasiGoz 1.0 kesit, kok AF2.2 tepe yuzune dokumle bagli (>=1.0); capraz delik ve ince aglar kaldirildi.

Etsy metni

Başlık 77/140

14K Gold Evil Eye Crescent Drop Earrings, Nazar Enamel Charm, Protection Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, evil eye earrings, nazar earrings, crescent moon, enamel earrings, vitreous enamel, protection amulet, talisman jewelry, gold drop earrings, evil eye jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, celestial jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

A small gold crescent with a traditional evil eye hanging below it, enamelled in navy-blue, white and ice-blue glass. It is a protection charm in 14k gold, given as a Christmas gift and worn all year.

THE PIECE
A polished crescent, 4.8 mm wide and 3.2 mm tall with its points up, sits on the lobe. Below it a 1.0 mm gold ring holds a flat disc 5.4 mm across and 1.4 mm thick. The eye on the disc is 4.0 mm across, inside a 0.7 mm polished gold rim. Overall length about 12 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.69 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.73 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque, in the traditional nazar order from the outside inward: a navy-blue ring, a white ring and an ice-blue ring, each 0.5 mm wide, and a navy-blue center dot 1.0 mm across. The colours are laid side by side in one cell and fired together, so each colour edge is soft by a fraction of a millimetre. The enamel sits level with the gold rim or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 12 mm long, sitting just below the lobe; the disc moves freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The crescent and the disc are cast separately in zinc-free 14k gold, and the enamel cell is formed in the casting itself. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the post is laser welded to the crescent, which never goes into the kiln, and the ring is closed with a laser weld well away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

A hilal: dis Ø4.8, ic Ø3.6 (1.2 yukari kacik), alt bant 1.8, uclar 0.8 r0.4, kalinlik 1.0, genislik 4.8, yukseklik 3.2 mm; arka civi pedi Ø1.6 x 0.3 (yerel 1.3); alt bantta dokum C-halka 1.0 kesit, ic Ø1.2, bosluk 1.1. B disk Ø5.4 x 1.4; ustte dokum KAPALI goz 1.0 kesit, ic Ø1.2. Tek yuvarlak hucre Ø4.0, 0.6 derin, taban 0.8, jant 0.70 (arka pah 0.7 x 0.5, dis kenar 0.9). Hucre ici renk bantlari distan iceri: lacivert r1.5-2.0 (0.5), beyaz r1.0-1.5 (0.5), buz mavisi r0.5-1.0 (0.5), lacivert gozbebegi Ø1.0. Toplam ~12 mm.

Iki parca, 14K cinkosuz. (A) hilal + ped + C-halka; civi A'ya lazer; A HICBIR ZAMAN firina girmez. (B) nazar diski + kapali goz; tek champleve hucre DOKUMDE (oyma yok), taban duz, doku yok. Nazar geleneksel sirasi tek hucrede yan yana islak dolumla kurulur (renkler arasi altin duvar yok; 3 renk ayni yumusak seri, ayni sicaklik). B 4 pisirimle bitirilir. Montaj: C-halka B gozune gecirilir; 1.1 mm bosluk 1.0 mm 14K tel tapayla iki uctan dolgusuz alin lazeri, mine maskeli, kaynak noktasi en yakin mineden >=2.5 mm. B'de lehim/kaynak yok. Tas yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: A hilal + ped + C-halka (bosluk 1.1), B disk + goz + Ø4.0 hucre; hucre koseleri r>=0.2; model +0.2 (hucre derinligi bitmis 0.6).
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum cinkosuz 14K (Zn sertifikali); B yollugu goz karsisina, A yollugu alt banda.
  3. Tesviye; B hucre tabaninda 10x gozenek kontrolu; hucre temizligi doku birakmadan.
  4. Seri oncesi pilot: ayni alasim + ayni dokumhaneden renk basina kupon, P1-P4 cevrimiyle pisirilir; igne deligi, kabarcik, catlak ve renk tonu gecmeden uretim yok.
  5. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) x3-4: ~593 C -> %10 H2SO4 pickle -> durulama (yalniz mineden ONCE; sonra asit yok).
  6. Islak dolum 1. sarj ince, ICTEN DISA ve renk renk: lacivert gozbebegi Ø1.0 -> buz mavisi bant -> beyaz bant -> dis lacivert bant; her bant ince samur fircayla bir oncekinin kenarina degerek, kuruduktan sonra; bant siniri +-0.1 mm (10x) -> P1 780 C x 1:45 dk.
  7. 2. sarj -> P2 780 C x 1:45 dk.
  8. 3. sarj (jant ustune hafif tasan) -> P3 780 C x 1:45 dk.
  9. Su altinda alundum tas/elmas pedle mineyi jant kotuna (0-0.05 mm alti) DUZ taslama; hucre kenarinda cip kontrolu.
  10. P4 parlatma pisirimi 770 C x 1:00 dk (toplam 4 pisirim, hepsi <=780 C).
  11. Hafif sitrik pickle + durulama (H2SO4/HNO3 banyo YOK).
  12. A: Stuller 1800 civiyi ped soketine lazer + burgu testi (A firin gormez -> civi sert kalir).
  13. B jant ve arka yuz el cilasi (mine maskeli).
  14. Montaj: C-halkayi B gozune gecir; mineyi Plasti-tac + gumus siperle maskele; 1.0 mm tapayi bosluga oturt, iki ucu dusuk guc alin lazeri; 2 kg cekme testi.
  15. QC: cift 1.69 g +-0.05; mine 10x igne deligi/cip; bant sirasi distan iceri lacivert-beyaz-buz mavisi-lacivert; bant genisligi 0.5 +-0.1; mine jant kotunda veya 0-0.05 mm alti.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari, CINKOSUZ 'enamelable' dokum alasimi (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy ile alasimlanmis; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + DSC solidus), vakum/inert gaz dokum; dokum metali ~1.19 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Mine: <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; renk: lacivert, beyaz, buz mavisi (nazar istisnasi: lacivert + beyaz); pisirilmis ~38 mg/cift
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • 2 x 1.0 mm sert cekme 14K sari tel tapa, 1.1 mm boy (0.864 mm3 = ~11 mg/adet, ~23 mg/cift; C-halka boslugu, iki uctan dolgusuz alin lazeri)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): A hilal (dogrulayici olcumu 9.15 mm2) x 1.0: +9.15 mm3 -> +0.2392 g; A civi pedi O1.6 x 0.3: +0.60 mm3 -> +0.0158 g; A civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; A dokum C-halka 1.0 kesit ID1.2, bosluk 1.1: +4.20 mm3 -> +0.1098 g; C-halka tapasi 1.0 tel x 1.1: +0.86 mm3 -> +0.0226 g; B nazar diski O5.4 x 1.4: +32.06 mm3 -> +0.8381 g; B tek yuvarlak hucre O4.0 x 0.6 (4 renk bandi): -7.54 mm3 -> -0.1971 g; B jant arka pahi 0.7x0.5: -2.71 mm3 -> -0.0709 g; B dokum kapali goz 1.0 kesit ID1.2: +4.20 mm3 -> +0.1098 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 1.0607 g, ALTIN 1.692 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.058 g)

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Renk bantlarinin birbirine akmasi (altin duvarsiz tek hucre)Icten disa renk renk ince sarj, her bant kurutulup sonraki; ayni yumusak seri tek sicaklik; kuponla 0.5 mm bant keskinligi onayi; QC bant +-0.1 mm.
Beyaz opagin altin uzerinde sararmasi / lacivert ton kaymasiRenk basina kupon ayni Zn-siz alasimda; pisirim <=780 C, 4 pisirim siniri.
Igne deligi / kabarcik (Zn, gozenek)Yazili Zn=0 alasim, vakum dokum, 10x hucre tabani, kupon.
Civi yumusamasiCivi A'da; A hic firina girmez; sert cekme civi lazerle.
C-halka kaynaginda mine catlamasiKaynak noktasi mineden >=2.5 mm, maske, dusuk guc; tapa tam kesit.
Salinimda hilal uclarinin mineye vurmasiB hilalin altinda asili; mine jant kotunun 0-0.05 mm altinda, jant 0.70 kenari korur.

Comet Tail Climber

14K Gold Comet Ear Climber Earrings, Lab Grown Sapphire, Ice Blue and White Celestial

Etsy metni

Başlık 85/140

14K Gold Comet Ear Climber Earrings, Lab Grown Sapphire, Ice Blue and White Celestial

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, ear climber, lab grown sapphire, comet earrings, celestial jewelry, lab blue sapphire, climber earrings, ear crawler, september birthstone, christmas gift, gift for her, flush set earrings, solid gold climber

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown blue sapphire, lab grown white sapphire, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

A comet for the ear: a pale ice-blue lab-grown sapphire at the head and three white lab-grown sapphires stepping down along a tapered 14k gold tail. It follows the edge of the ear, makes a bright Christmas gift and wears well every day of the year.

THE PIECE
Each climber is 16.6 mm long and gently curved. The round head is 3.2 mm across and 1.8 mm thick. A bar 2.4 mm to 2.1 mm wide and 1.5 mm thick carries the three white stones, then tapers into a faceted tail 7.8 mm long that ends in a rounded 0.8 mm tip.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.60 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.63 g in total with the stones. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
Eight lab-grown sapphires in the pair, 0.152 ct in total. Each climber has one 2.0 mm round pale ice-blue sapphire in the head and three round white sapphires of 1.5, 1.4 and 1.3 mm along the bar. Every stone is flush set in its own seat, table level with the gold, over a small hole. The stones are set last, after all polishing.

LENGTH AND FIT
16.6 mm long. The head rests on the lobe with the post behind it, and the tail runs up along the outer edge of the ear. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back. The curve is fixed in the casting; please do not bend the climber, as bending can loosen the flush-set stones.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each climber is cast in 14k gold in one piece with its curve, the tail edges are cut bright, and the post is laser welded, so there is no solder. The stones are set cold, after the last polish, each in its own seat.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth; warm water, mild soap and a soft brush clean the holes behind the stones. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Toplam 16.6 mm (bas Ø3.2 x 1.8; tas cubugu 5.6 mm, 2.4 -> 2.1 gen., 1.5 kalin; kuyruk 7.8 mm, 2.1 -> 0.8 gen., 1.2 -> 0.7 kalin, uc r0.4; model ucu 1.0 x 0.9 -> bitmis 0.8 x 0.7). Yuva kenarlari arasi 0.5 mm. Civi bas merkezinden 1.17 mm kuyruk yonunde. Egri modelde (heliks), dokumden sonra bukulmez.

Tek parca egri dokum 14K; kulak heliksine gore modelde egilmis, dokumden sonra BUKULMEZ (flush yuvalar acilmasin). Yolluk tas cubugunun kokune. Taslar tek tek flush (kanal yok), her yuvanin altinda delik (Ø0.9 / Ø0.7). Civi Stuller 1800, bas ile ilk yuva arasindaki Ø0.8 x 0.5 sokete lazer (iki delige 0.32/0.33 mm). Mine yok, lehim yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: heliks egrisi modelde; 4 yuva pilotu + alt delikler; civi soketi; model +0.2 (fasetli kenarda +0.3).
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum; yolluk cubuk kokune.
  3. Tesviye (egriyi bukmeden), kuyruk faset kenarlarinin elmas tras islemi.
  4. Civi lazer kaynak + burgu testi.
  5. Yuvalar: delik kontrol (Ø0.9/0.7), yuva frezesi 2.0/1.5/1.4/1.3; tas partisini kumpasla olc (lab melee >%63 derin olabilir).
  6. Taslar en son, soguk: once bas 2.0 buz mavisi, sonra 1.5 -> 1.4 -> 1.3 flush.
  7. Son cila, ultrasonik.
  8. QC: cift 1.60 g +-0.05; 8 tas sallanma testi; kuyruk ucu yuvarlakligi; 5 farkli kulak maketinde oturma ve one devrilme kontrolu.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari; renk birligi icin mineli parcalarla AYNI cinkosuz alasim lotu (Otto Frei 846-180 bazli); mine yok, cinko sart degil; dokum metali ~1.11 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Taslar: 2 x 2.0 mm lab mavi safir acik buz mavisi (0.034 ct) + 2 x 1.5 (0.017) + 2 x 1.4 (0.014) + 2 x 1.3 (0.011) lab beyaz safir = 0.152 ct/cift
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): bas topuzu O3.2 x 1.8: +14.48 mm3 -> +0.3784 g; 2.0 yuva + O0.9 delik: -2.61 mm3 -> -0.0682 g; tas cubugu L5.6 w2.4->2.1 t1.5: +18.90 mm3 -> +0.4940 g; 1.5/1.4/1.3 yuvalari + O0.7 delikler: -3.14 mm3 -> -0.0821 g; kuyruk kama L7.8 w2.1->0.8 t1.2->0.7 (k=0.85): +9.49 mm3 -> +0.2481 g; civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 0.9637 g, ALTIN 1.595 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.155 g)

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Musterinin tirmaniciyi bukmesi -> flush taslarin gevsemesi1.5 mm rijit kesit; aciklamada ve bakim kartinda 'bukmeyin'; egri kulak maketlerinde dogrulanir.
Tas dusmesi (ince yanal duvar)Ev sahibi 1.5/1.8 mm, yanal duvar 0.43 (>=0.35), yuva arasi 0.5 mm.
One devrilme / kulaktan ayrilma (tek friction arkalik)Kuyruk heliks kenarina yaslanir; 5 kulak maketi provasi; gerekirse S/M iki egri.
Kuyruk ucunun kulaga batmasiUc 0.8 mm r0.4.

Etsy metni

Başlık 75/140

14K Gold Stirrup Hoop Earrings, Hinged Equestrian Huggies, Horse Lover Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, stirrup earrings, equestrian gift, hinged hoops, gold huggie hoops, horse jewelry, equestrian jewelry, hoop earrings, horse lover gift, christmas gift, unisex earrings, solid gold hoops, gift for rider

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold

Açıklama

A stirrup in 14k gold, made as a hinged hoop that clicks shut through the ear. It is an equestrian classic for riders and horse lovers, an easy Christmas gift with no seasonal detail at all.

THE PIECE
Each hoop is 11.3 mm wide and 10.1 mm tall. A round arch of 1.0 mm gold wire rises over the top and meets two short sides, 1.3 mm by 1.1 mm, standing on a flat bottom bar 11.3 mm long and 1.8 mm tall with three bright crosswise grooves. The inside opening is 8.7 mm wide.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.43 g of 14k gold for the pair; hoops need no posts or backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.43 g in total. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

LENGTH AND FIT
11.3 mm wide and 10.1 mm tall, sitting close to the lobe. The left side and the arch open on a hinge at the lower corner; the arch wire passes through the piercing and clicks into a catch at the top of the right side, held by a small spring-hard 14k gold tongue. The wire that passes through the ear is 1.0 mm (18 gauge).

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The two halves are cast in 14k gold. The hinge is a hard 14k gold pin riveted cold at both ends, and the spring tongue is laser welded, so there is no solder anywhere and the catch keeps its spring.

CARE
Wipe with a soft cloth; warm water and mild soap are fine. Open and close the hinge gently, without forcing it past its stop. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Dis 11.3 x 10.1 mm, ic aciklik 8.7 x 7.3 mm. Kemer 180 derece, merkez hat R5.0, YUVARLAK Ø1.0 tel (kulaktan gecen bolum, 18G; eski 1.3 x 1.1). Bacaklar 2.8 mm, kesit 1.3 x 1.1 (kemere gecis 1.0 mm'ye yumusak). Taban 11.3 x 1.8 x 1.1, 3 V-oluk 0.5 x 0.4. Mentese topuzu Ø2.8 x 2.2 (2 x 1.1; on/arka yuzden 0.55 mm tasar), pim Ø0.8. Kilit blogu 1.6 mm kup (sag bacak tepesi): kemer ucu icin Ø1.05 x 1.0 yuva + 0.4 x 1.0 x 1.6 yay dili yarigi.

Iki dokum parca 14K: (A) sabit: taban + sag bacak + kilit blogu + alt mentese topuzu; (B) acilan: sol bacak + Ø1.0 kemer + ust topuz. Geometri kapanir: kemer kirisi 2R = 10.0 mm = taban uzerindeki bacak eksen araligi. Mentese: dokum topuzlar hizali delinir (Ø0.8), sert cekme 14K pim sokulup iki ucundan soguk percinlenir - LEHIM YOK. Kapanma: kemerin kubbe uclu Ø1.0 ucu kilit blogundaki Ø1.05 yuvaya girer; yariga lazerle kaynakli yay sertliginde 14K dil ucu 0.3 mm on-yukle yandan sikistirir (surtunmeli klik). Kemer ucunda yarik/olu yok -> Ø1.0 kesit kesintisiz. Tas yok, mine yok, hollow yok, civi/arkalik yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: iki parca kapali kati; kemer Ø1.0 yuvarlak, kiris = taban araligi kontrolu; topuzlarda Ø0.5 pilot; kilit blogu yuva + dil yarigi; model +0.2 mm (kemer modelde Ø1.2 -> bitmis Ø1.0).
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum; yolluk taban arkasina ve kemer tepesine.
  3. Tesviye; kemerin kulaktan gecen bolumu ve ic yuzeyler ayna cila; kemer ucu kubbe r0.5.
  4. Topuzlari aparatta hizali Ø0.8 del; pimi sok, iki ucu soguk percinle.
  5. Kilit blogu yarigina yay dilini lazerle kaynakla (lehim yok); 0.3 mm on-yuk ayari.
  6. Taban oluklarinin elmas tras kesimi, son cila.
  7. QC: cift 1.43 g +-0.05; kemer Ø1.0 +-0.03 (kumpas); 200 ac-kapa dongusu sonrasi tutus; mentese boslugu <=0.3 mm.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari; renk birligi icin mineli parcalarla AYNI cinkosuz alasim lotu (Otto Frei 846-180 bazli); dokum metali ~1.58 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • 2 x sert cekme 14K pim Ø0.8 x 2.4 mm (0.016 g/adet)
  • 2 x 14K yay sertliginde yassi dil 0.4 x 1.0 x 2.5 mm (0.013 g/adet)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): kemer 180 deg, R5.0, yuvarlak O1.0: +12.34 mm3 -> +0.3225 g; 2 bacak 2.8 x 1.3 x 1.1: +8.01 mm3 -> +0.2093 g; uzengi tabani 11.3 x 1.8 x 1.1: +22.37 mm3 -> +0.5849 g; 3 enine V-oluk 0.5x0.4: -0.54 mm3 -> -0.0141 g; mentese blogu O2.8x2.2 - pim deligi - tel ortusmesi (dogrulayici): +7.87 mm3 -> +0.2057 g; kilit blogu 1.6^3 - O1.05x1.0 yuva - 0.4x1.0x1.6 dil yarigi: +2.59 mm3 -> +0.0677 g; mentese pimi O0.8 x 2.4 (satin alma): +1.21 mm3 -> +0.0315 g; yay dili 0.4x1.0x2.5 (satin alma): +1.00 mm3 -> +0.0261 g => govde 1.4337 g, ALTIN 1.434 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.316 g)

Ince kemerin egilmesiØ1.0 kati kesit, 180 derece kemer kisa; acma kapama durdurucuya kadar.
Mentese boslugunda meme sikismasiTopuz boslugu <=0.3 mm, kenarlar kirik.

Ice Blue Teardrop Drop

14K Gold Ice Blue Enamel Teardrop Earrings, Fired Glass Enamel Drop, Winter Dangle

Damla mevsimsiz arketip; Ocak'tan sonra 'ice blue enamel teardrop' olarak mavi mine aramalarinda satar.

Etsy metni

Başlık 82/140

14K Gold Ice Blue Enamel Teardrop Earrings, Fired Glass Enamel Drop, Winter Dangle

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, ice blue enamel, enamel earrings, teardrop earrings, gold drop earrings, vitreous enamel, winter jewelry, blue drop earrings, champleve enamel, christmas gift, gift for her, icy blue jewelry, dangle earrings

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

A small teardrop of ice-blue glass enamel in a polished 14k gold border, hanging point up from a domed gold disc. Clear winter blue for a Christmas gift, and a simple drop that is worn the whole year.

THE PIECE
A domed gold disc 3.4 mm across sits on the lobe. A 1.0 mm gold ring joins it to the teardrop, which is 7.2 mm long, 4.6 mm wide and 1.4 mm thick, with a 0.7 mm polished gold border. Overall length about 12.5 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.69 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.72 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice-blue. The enamel fills the teardrop flat and level with the gold border or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 12.5 mm long, sitting just below the lobe; the teardrop moves freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The disc and the teardrop are cast separately in zinc-free 14k gold, and the enamel cell is formed in the casting itself. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the post is laser welded to the disc, which never goes into the kiln, and the ring is closed with a laser weld well away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

A: Ø3.4 x 0.9 + 0.3 kubbe (merkez 1.2; soket sonrasi 0.7); altta dokum C-halka 1.0 kesit, ic Ø1.2, bosluk 1.1. B: damla (Ø4.6 alt daire + Ø1.2 ust daire zarfi) 7.2 x 4.6 x 1.4 mm, ucu yukari; ucta dokum KAPALI goz 1.0 kesit, ic Ø1.2. Hucre (Ø3.2 + Ø0.7 zarf) 0.6 derin, taban 0.8, jant 0.70, jant arka pahi 0.7 x 0.5. Mine DUZ, jant kotunda (0-0.05 mm alti). Toplam ~12.5 mm.

Iki parca 14K cinkosuz. (A) kubbeli disk + dokum ACIK C-halka; civi A'ya lazer; A firin gormez. (B) damla plaka + dokum KAPALI goz; hucre dokumde, taban duz, doku yok; 4 pisirim; mine taslanarak DUZ biter. Montaj: C-halka B gozune gecirilir; 1.1 mm bosluk 1.0 mm 14K tel tapa ile iki uctan dolgusuz alin lazeri, mine maskeli; kaynak-mine mesafesi >=3.5 mm. B'de lehim/kaynak yok. Tas yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: A disk + C-halka (bosluk 1.1), B damla + goz; hucre modelde, uc r0.35; model +0.2 mm.
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum cinkosuz 14K; B yollugu alt yaya (gozun karsisi).
  3. Tesviye, 10x hucre tabani gozenek kontrolu, hucre temizligi (doku yok).
  4. Seri oncesi pilot: ayni alasim + ayni dokumhaneden renk basina kupon, P1-P4 cevrimiyle pisirilir; igne deligi, kabarcik, catlak ve renk tonu gecmeden uretim yok.
  5. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) x3-4: ~593 C -> %10 H2SO4 pickle -> durulama (yalniz mineden ONCE; sonra asit yok).
  6. Islak dolum 1. sarj ince (buz mavisi) -> kurut -> P1 780 C x 1:45 dk (kalibre pirometre, firin termokupl kontrolu).
  7. 2. sarj -> P2 780 C x 1:45 dk.
  8. 3. sarj (jant ustune hafif tasan) -> P3 780 C x 1:45 dk.
  9. Su altinda alundum tas/elmas pedle mineyi jant kotuna (0-0.05 mm alti) DUZ taslama; hucre kenarinda cip kontrolu.
  10. P4 parlatma pisirimi 770 C x 1:00 dk (toplam 4 pisirim, hepsi <=780 C).
  11. Hafif sitrik pickle + durulama (H2SO4/HNO3 banyo YOK).
  12. A: civi lazer + burgu testi (A firin gormez).
  13. Montaj: C-halkayi B gozune gecir, mine maskeli; 1.0 mm tapa iki uctan alin lazeri; 2 kg cekme testi.
  14. El cilasi yalniz ciplak altina; QC: cift 1.69 g +-0.05; mine 10x; mine duz ve jant kotunda; salinim serbestligi.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari, CINKOSUZ 'enamelable' dokum alasimi (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy ile alasimlanmis; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + DSC solidus), vakum/inert gaz dokum; dokum metali ~1.19 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Mine: <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; renk: buz mavisi; pisirilmis ~30 mg/cift
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • 2 x 1.0 mm sert cekme 14K sari tel tapa, 1.1 mm boy (0.864 mm3 = ~11 mg/adet, ~23 mg/cift; C-halka boslugu, iki uctan dolgusuz alin lazeri)

A hamsa hand in 14k gold with a ring of deep jade-green glass enamel around a lab-grown white sapphire in the palm. A protection charm that makes a thoughtful Christmas gift and is worn every day after.

THE PIECE
Each stud is 6.8 mm wide and 8.9 mm tall, fingers up. Three fingers and two outward-turned thumbs form one plate, divided by fine bright grooves. The round palm is 5.3 mm across and 1.4 mm thick, with a 0.7 mm enamel ring around a 2.5 mm polished gold center and a 0.7 mm gold rim.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.68 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.70 g in total with the enamel and stones. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade-green. The enamel ring sits level with the gold or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

STONES
Two 1.3 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, one in the center of each palm, 0.022 ct in total. Each is flush set in bare gold, table level with the gold, over a small hole, and set by hand after the enamel firings are finished.

LENGTH AND FIT
8.9 mm tall. The post sits behind the fingers, above the middle of the piece, so the hamsa stays upright with its fingers up. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each hamsa is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece, with the enamel cell formed in the casting. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the hard gold post is laser welded on afterwards, on a pad away from the enamel, and the sapphire is set last, after the firings.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

6.8 x 8.9 mm. Avuc Ø5.3 x 1.4; ada Ø2.5 (+0.1 on kabartma, yerel 1.5); hucre halkasi r1.25-1.95 (0.70), 0.6 derin, taban 0.8, jant 0.70; jant arka pahi 0.7 x 0.5 YALNIZ serbest avuc kenarinda (parmaklara bagli ust ~%40 pahsiz). Parmaklar tek plaka 0.8 kalin, oluklar 0.4 x 0.2. Civi pedi Ø2.2 arka kabartma (yerel 1.2), avuc merkezinin 4.6 mm ustu; ped-hucre plan 1.55 mm.

Tek parca dokum 14K cinkosuz; hucre halkasi dokumde. Civi pedi parmak bolgesinde (ciplak altin), hucreden plan 1.55 mm. Tas yuvasi frezesi ve Ø0.7 delik dokum tesviyesinden sonra, MINEDEN ONCE acilir (ciplak altin adada, mine girmez). Pisirimlerden sonra civi lazer, en son tas: 1.3 mm safir el itme/burnisher ile (cekic yok), mine maskeli. Lehim yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: hucre halkasi dokum hucresi, ada +0.1, Ø0.7 alt delik pilotu, parmak bolgesinde ped Ø2.2 + soket; ped-hucre plan >=1.5 olcumu; pah yalniz serbest avuc kenarinda.
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum cinkosuz 14K; yolluk ped arkasina.
  3. Tesviye, 10x gozenek, hucre temizligi; parmak oluklari mineden ONCE kesilir.
  4. Tas yuvasi: Ø0.7 delik kontrol + Ø1.3 yuva frezesi MINEDEN ONCE (titresim/capak pisirilmis mineye degmez).
  5. Seri oncesi pilot: ayni alasim + ayni dokumhaneden renk basina kupon, P1-P4 cevrimiyle pisirilir; igne deligi, kabarcik, catlak ve renk tonu gecmeden uretim yok.
  6. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) x3-4: ~593 C -> %10 H2SO4 pickle -> durulama (yalniz mineden ONCE; sonra asit yok).
  7. Islak dolum 1. sarj ince (derin yesim yesili) -> kurut -> P1 780 C x 1:30 dk (kalibre pirometre, firin termokupl kontrolu).
  8. 2. sarj -> P2 780 C x 1:30 dk.
  9. 3. sarj (jant ustune hafif tasan) -> P3 780 C x 1:30 dk.
  10. Su altinda alundum tas/elmas pedle mineyi jant kotuna (0-0.05 mm alti) DUZ taslama; hucre kenarinda cip kontrolu.
  11. P4 parlatma pisirimi 770 C x 1:00 dk (toplam 4 pisirim, hepsi <=780 C).
  12. Hafif sitrik pickle + durulama (H2SO4/HNO3 banyo YOK).
  13. Yuvayi pisirim kirinden temizle (yalniz mekanik, asit yok).
  14. Mineyi Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siperle maskele; Stuller 1800 sert civiyi ped soketine (Ø0.8 x 0.5) oturt, dusuk guc lazer, hava nozuluyla sogut (Staley yontemi).
  15. Civi testi: penseyle cekerken yarim-tam tur burgu (Revere) -> is sertlestirme + kaynak testi; civi dikligi 90 +-3 derece.
  16. Tas: 1.3 mm lab beyaz safiri hazir yuvaya el itme ucu/burnisher ile flush oturt; cekic KULLANILMAZ; mine maskeli.
  17. El cilasi yalniz ciplak altina; ultrasonik yok.
  18. QC: cift 1.68 g +-0.05; mine 10x; tas testi; ada-mine sinirinda catlak yok.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari, CINKOSUZ 'enamelable' dokum alasimi (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy ile alasimlanmis; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + DSC solidus), vakum/inert gaz dokum; dokum metali ~1.20 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Mine: <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; renk: derin yesim yesili; pisirilmis ~21 mg/cift
  • Taslar: 2 x 1.3 mm lab-grown beyaz safir (0.011 ct) = 0.022 ct
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): avuc O5.3 x 1.4: +30.89 mm3 -> +0.8074 g; halka hucre r1.25-1.95 x 0.6: -4.22 mm3 -> -0.1104 g; ada on kabartma O2.5 x 0.1: +0.49 mm3 -> +0.0128 g; 1.3 yuva + O0.7 delik: -0.92 mm3 -> -0.0240 g; avuc jant arka pahi yalniz serbest kenar (dogrulayici): -1.60 mm3 -> -0.0418 g; parmaklar + basparmaklar 18.25 mm2 x 0.8: +14.60 mm3 -> +0.3816 g; 4 parmak olugu 0.4x0.2 x2.8: -0.45 mm3 -> -0.0117 g; civi pedi O2.2 x 0.4 (arka): +1.52 mm3 -> +0.0397 g; civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 1.0471 g, ALTIN 1.679 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.071 g)

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Yuva frezesinin pisirilmis mineyi ciplemesiYuva ve delik mineden ONCE acilir; pisirim sonrasi yalniz el itme oturtma.
Tas oturtma kuvvetinin mineyi catlatmasiAda kenari 0.60 mm, cekic yok, el itme + maske; tas en son.
Lazer isisinin mineyi catlatmasiPed parmak bolgesinde, hucreye plan 1.55 mm; maske + dusuk guc + hava sogutma.
Civi tavlanmasiCivi pisirim SONRASI sert cekme + lazer.
Ince halka minenin kalkmasiHalka 0.70 gen. x 0.6 derin, dokum hucre duvarlari dik + koseler r0.2.

Tolerans

KuralDeğer
L1 karat + cinkosuz14K, Zn=0✓
L2 hucre 0.5-0.6 derin, >=0.7 gen., derinlik <=2 x gen.0.6 / 0.70 / 0.6 <= 1.4✓
L2 cevre duvar >=0.70, taban >=0.8jant 0.70, taban 0.8✓
L2 renk1: derin yesim yesili✓
L2/KANIT pisirim <=4, <=780 C780/780/780/770 C✓
L3/KANIT ped-hucre plan >=1.5, ped >=0.81.55 mm; yerel 1.2 mm✓
L4 tas ciplak altinda, yuva-mine >=0.60.60 mm; yuva mineden once✓
L4 ev sahibi 1.3 mm tas >=1.5, yanal duvar >=0.35, alt delik1.5 mm; 0.60 mm; Ø0.7✓
L5 parmak yapisal >=0.8, oluk sonrasi >=0.6, uc r>=0.40.8 / 0.6 / r0.4✓
L7 cift altin 1.40-1.75; tavana pay >=0.051.679 g; pay 0.071✓
L9 stud <=128.9 mm✓
L12 tek kahramanhamsa silueti + yesil avuc halkasi✓

Berry Lantern Stud

14K Gold Lantern Stud Earrings, Berry Enamel Windows, Cozy Holiday Gift for Her

Fener kis boyu 'cozy' estetiginde ve Ramazan/fener temalarinda satar; baslikta tarihli kelime yok, Ocak'ta yalniz 'christmas lantern' etiketi degisir.

Etsy metni

Başlık 79/140

14K Gold Lantern Stud Earrings, Berry Enamel Windows, Cozy Holiday Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, lantern earrings, lantern studs, berry enamel, enamel earrings, vitreous enamel, gold stud earrings, holiday earrings, winter jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, christmas lantern, cottage jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

A small gold lantern with two arched windows of deep berry glass enamel, framed in polished 14k gold. It brings a warm note to a Christmas gift and stays a cosy everyday stud through winter and beyond.

THE PIECE
Each stud is 5.4 mm wide and 9.9 mm tall: a closed round ring 2.6 mm across on top, a sloped roof with rounded eaves, a square body 4.6 mm wide with two arched windows 1.25 mm wide and 3.1 mm tall, and a flat foot 5.0 mm wide. The plate is 0.85 mm thick, 1.4 mm behind the windows.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.65 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.67 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry, a dark raspberry-purple. The enamel fills both windows level with the gold or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
9.9 mm tall. The post sits behind the roof, above the middle of the piece, so the lantern stays upright on the lobe. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each lantern is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece, with the window cells formed in the casting. The enamel is fired four times at 760 C. There is no solder: the hard gold post is laser welded on afterwards, on a pad away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Fener stud 5.4 x 9.9 mm, duz plaka 0.85 mm (model 1.05), cevre pahi 0.25 x 0.25. Alttan uste: ayak 5.0 x 0.8 (alt koseler r0.4); govde 4.6 x 4.6; cati yamuk 5.4 -> 2.4 gen., 2.0 yuks., sacak koseleri r0.4; tepe kapali halka dis Ø2.6, ic Ø1.0 (tel 0.8), cati ustune 0.1 mm gomulu. Govde arkasi yerel 1.4 (+0.55 arka yuzde). 2 kemerli pencere hucresi: her biri 1.25 gen. x 3.1 yuks. (ust kemer r0.625), 0.6 derin, taban 0.8; yan cerceve 0.7, orta kayit 0.7, alt cerceve 0.7, ust cerceve 0.8. Civi pedi Ø2.0 x 0.35 arka yuzde (yerel 1.2), ayak altindan 7.0 mm yukarida (cati); ped-hucre plan 1.55 mm; ped ust kenari ile halka deligi arasi 0.1 mm.

Tek parca dokum 14K cinkosuz; iki pencere hucresi dokumde. Civi pedi catida (ciplak altin), kutle merkezinin ustunde -> fener dik durur. Kalinlasma yalniz ARKA yuzde (on yuz duz). Tum pisirimler 760 C (bogurtlen, bant alt ucu). Civi pisirim sonrasi lazer. Tas yok, lehim yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: fener plaka 1.05 (model), govde arkasi +0.55, pencere hucreleri modelde (kemer r0.625, koseler r0.2), cati pedi + soket; ped-hucre plan >=1.5 olcumu.
  2. 250 px kucuk resim okunurluk testi (fener silueti) CAD onayindan once.
  3. Recine baski -> vakum dokum cinkosuz 14K; yolluk ped arkasina.
  4. Tesviye, 10x gozenek, hucre temizligi; cevre pahi ve halka ici mineden once.
  5. Seri oncesi pilot: ayni alasim + ayni dokumhaneden renk basina kupon, P1-P4 cevrimiyle pisirilir; igne deligi, kabarcik, catlak ve renk tonu gecmeden uretim yok.
  6. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) x3-4: ~593 C -> %10 H2SO4 pickle -> durulama (yalniz mineden ONCE; sonra asit yok).
  7. Islak dolum 1. sarj ince (derin bogurtlen, tek renk) -> kurut -> P1 760 C x 2:00 dk (kalibre pirometre, firin termokupl kontrolu).
  8. 2. sarj -> P2 760 C x 2:00 dk.
  9. 3. sarj (jant ustune hafif tasan) -> P3 760 C x 2:00 dk.
  10. Su altinda alundum tas/elmas pedle mineyi jant kotuna (0-0.05 mm alti) DUZ taslama; hucre kenarinda cip kontrolu.
  11. P4 parlatma pisirimi 760 C x 1:00 dk (toplam 4 pisirim, hepsi <=780 C).
  12. Hafif sitrik pickle + durulama (H2SO4/HNO3 banyo YOK).
  13. Mineyi Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siperle maskele; Stuller 1800 sert civiyi ped soketine (Ø0.8 x 0.5) oturt, dusuk guc lazer, hava nozuluyla sogut (Staley yontemi).
  14. Civi testi: penseyle cekerken yarim-tam tur burgu (Revere) -> is sertlestirme + kaynak testi; civi dikligi 90 +-3 derece.
  15. El cilasi yalniz ciplak altina; ultrasonik yok.
  16. QC: cift 1.65 g +-0.05; bogurtlen ton kupon referansiyla; mine 10x; orta kayit 0.7 surekliligi.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari, CINKOSUZ 'enamelable' dokum alasimi (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy ile alasimlanmis; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + DSC solidus), vakum/inert gaz dokum; dokum metali ~1.17 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Mine: <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; renk: derin bogurtlen (koyu ahududu-mor; Cd/Se icerigi teyit); pisirilmis ~22 mg/cift
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): fener plaka (ayak 3.93 + govde 21.16 + cati 7.73 + halka 4.46 = 37.28 mm2) x 0.85: +31.69 mm3 -> +0.8283 g; govde bolgesi arka kalinlasma 4.6x4.6 x 0.55 (yerel 1.4): +11.64 mm3 -> +0.3042 g; 2 kemerli pencere hucresi 2 x 3.707 mm2 x 0.6: -4.45 mm3 -> -0.1163 g; cevre pahi 0.25x0.25 x cevre ~30.6: -0.95 mm3 -> -0.0248 g; civi pedi O2.0 x 0.35 (arka, cati): +1.10 mm3 -> +0.0287 g; civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 1.0136 g, ALTIN 1.645 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.105 g)

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Bogurtlenin yanmasi/kararmasiTum pisirimler 760 C, kisa, tek renk.
Orta kayit (0.7) ya da cerceve sarkmasiKayit/cerceve 0.7, taban 0.8 + govde arkasi 1.4 rijit cekirdek; 760 C.
Lazer isisiyla mine catlamasiPed catida, hucreden plan 1.55 mm, maske, dusuk guc.

L5 uc r>=0.4ayak ve sacak koseleri r0.4✓

Cardinal Stud

Kardinal ABD'de anma/hatira kusu; Ocak'tan sonra 'memorial' ve 'sympathy gift' aramalariyla yil boyu satar.

Etsy metni

Başlık 81/140

14K Gold Cardinal Bird Stud Earrings, Berry Enamel Breast, Memorial Keepsake Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, cardinal earrings, cardinal bird gift, bird earrings, memorial gift, sympathy gift, berry enamel, enamel earrings, gold stud earrings, bird lover gift, christmas gift, gift for her, remembrance gift

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

A cardinal in 14k gold, upright in side profile, with its breast in deep berry glass enamel. Cardinals are kept as a sign of remembrance, which makes this pair a gentle Christmas gift that carries on through the year.

THE PIECE
Each stud is 5.8 mm wide and 11.5 mm tall. Head, peaked crest, cone beak and tail are polished gold, with a round polished eye recess 0.9 mm across and three bright grooves across the tail. The oval enamel field on the breast is 3.2 mm wide and 3.7 mm tall, inside a gold border at least 0.7 mm wide.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.59 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.62 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry, a dark raspberry-purple that is deeper than a bright cardinal red. The enamel sits level with the gold or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
11.5 mm tall. The post sits behind the head, so the bird stays upright on the lobe. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each cardinal is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece, with the enamel cell formed in the casting. The enamel is fired four times at 760 C. There is no solder: the hard gold post is laser welded on afterwards, on a pad away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

5.8 x 11.45 mm. Plaka 0.9 (model 1.1); govde hucre bolgesi ARKA yuzde +0.5 (yerel 1.4), on yuz duz; hucre oval 3.2 x 3.7, 0.6 derin, taban 0.8, jant min 0.73. Goz kor cukur Ø0.9 x 0.3. Kuyruk 3 oluk 0.5 x 0.25. Tepelik, gaga ve kuyruk uclari r0.4. Civi pedi Ø2.2 (yerel 1.2) basin arkasinda; ped-hucre plan 1.62 mm.

Tek parca dokum 14K cinkosuz; hucre dokumde. Kus dik durusta: bas ustte, civi basin arkasinda, kutle merkezinin ustunde. Bas/tepelik/gaga ciplak altin (civi pedi alani). Kalinlasma yalniz arka yuzde. Bogurtlen tum pisirimlerde 760 C. Civi pisirim sonrasi lazer. Tas yok, lehim yok, dal/tunek yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 250 px kucuk resim okunurluk testi (altin basli kardinal silueti) CAD onayindan ONCE.
  2. CAD: hucre modelde, kalinlasma arka yuzde, goz kor cukur, bas pedi + soket; uclar r0.4; model +0.2.
  3. Recine baski -> vakum dokum cinkosuz 14K; yolluk bas pedine.
  4. Tesviye, 10x gozenek, hucre temizligi; kuyruk oluklari ve goz cukuru mineden once.
  5. Seri oncesi pilot: ayni alasim + ayni dokumhaneden renk basina kupon, P1-P4 cevrimiyle pisirilir; igne deligi, kabarcik, catlak ve renk tonu gecmeden uretim yok.
  6. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) x3-4: ~593 C -> %10 H2SO4 pickle -> durulama (yalniz mineden ONCE; sonra asit yok).
  7. Islak dolum 1. sarj ince (derin bogurtlen) -> kurut -> P1 760 C x 2:00 dk (kalibre pirometre, firin termokupl kontrolu).
  8. 2. sarj -> P2 760 C x 2:00 dk.
  9. 3. sarj (jant ustune hafif tasan) -> P3 760 C x 2:00 dk.
  10. Su altinda alundum tas/elmas pedle mineyi jant kotuna (0-0.05 mm alti) DUZ taslama; hucre kenarinda cip kontrolu.
  11. P4 parlatma pisirimi 760 C x 1:00 dk (toplam 4 pisirim, hepsi <=780 C).
  12. Hafif sitrik pickle + durulama (H2SO4/HNO3 banyo YOK).
  13. Mineyi Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siperle maskele; Stuller 1800 sert civiyi ped soketine (Ø0.8 x 0.5) oturt, dusuk guc lazer, hava nozuluyla sogut (Staley yontemi).
  14. Civi testi: penseyle cekerken yarim-tam tur burgu (Revere) -> is sertlestirme + kaynak testi; civi dikligi 90 +-3 derece.
  15. El cilasi: tepelik, gaga, kuyruk; mine maskeli; ultrasonik yok.
  16. QC: cift 1.59 g +-0.05; bogurtlen ton; uclar r0.4; mine 10x.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari, CINKOSUZ 'enamelable' dokum alasimi (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy ile alasimlanmis; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + DSC solidus), vakum/inert gaz dokum; dokum metali ~1.10 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Mine: <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; renk: derin bogurtlen (koyu ahududu-mor); pisirilmis ~28 mg/cift
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): kus silueti 36.25 mm2 x 0.9: +32.62 mm3 -> +0.8528 g; govde hucre bolgesi arka +0.5 (18.44 mm2): +9.22 mm3 -> +0.2410 g; govde hucresi 9.30 mm2 x 0.6: -5.58 mm3 -> -0.1459 g; kor goz O0.9 x 0.3: -0.19 mm3 -> -0.0050 g; kuyruk 3 oluk: -0.27 mm3 -> -0.0071 g; civi pedi O2.2 x 0.3: +1.14 mm3 -> +0.0298 g; civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 0.9592 g, ALTIN 1.591 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.159 g)

Scarab Stud

14K Gold Scarab Beetle Stud Earrings, Jade Green Enamel, Egyptian Amulet Studs
