14K sarı altın1.66 g altınMine: derin yesim yesili

Sifir Noel icerigi; skarabe muska talebi yil boyu, Ocak'ta yalniz 'christmas gift' etiketi degisir.

Etsy metni

Başlık 78/140

14K Gold Scarab Beetle Stud Earrings, Jade Green Enamel, Egyptian Amulet Studs

Etiketler (13)

14k gold earrings, scarab earrings, scarab beetle, beetle earrings, egyptian jewelry, amulet jewelry, green enamel, enamel earrings, jade green enamel, gold stud earrings, christmas gift, unisex earrings, talisman jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k gold earring posts, 14k gold friction backs

Açıklama

A scarab beetle in 14k gold with its two wing covers in deep jade-green glass enamel. The old amulet of renewal, given as a Christmas gift and worn the whole year.

THE PIECE
Each stud is 5.2 mm wide and 9.3 mm long, gently curved across its width. The head and the plate behind it are polished gold with two lengthwise grooves. The two wing covers are split by a 0.7 mm gold center line inside a 0.7 mm gold border. The shell is 0.9 mm thick, 1.4 mm behind the enamel.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.66 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.70 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade-green. The enamel follows the gentle curve of the shell, level with the gold or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
9.3 mm long. The post sits behind the head plate, so the scarab stays upright on the lobe. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each scarab is cast in zinc-free 14k gold in one piece, with the enamel cells formed in the casting. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the hard gold post is laser welded on afterwards, on a pad away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

5.2 x 9.25 mm; enine tek egrilik, yukselti 0.5 mm / 5.2 mm kiris (gelisim faktoru 1.024). Kabuk 0.9 mm (model 1.1); elytra hucre bolgesi ARKA yuzde +0.5 (yerel 1.4), on yuz kabuk egrisini izler. 2 hucre DIKDORTGEN 1.55 x 3.75 mm, koseler r0.35 (5.71 mm2/adet), 0.6 derin, taban 0.8; omurga 0.70, jant 0.70, ust bant 1.35. Pronotum 2 boyuna oluk 0.5 x 0.25. Civi pedi Ø2.2 (yerel 1.2), ped-hucre plan 1.63 mm.

Tek parca dokum 14K cinkosuz; tek egrilikli kabuk, kalinlasma yalniz arka yuzde (kapali bosluk yok -> hollow degil). Hucreler dokumde. Civi pronotum arkasindaki pede pisirim sonrasi lazer. Tas yok, lehim yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. CAD: kapali kati egri kabuk (gelisim alani), arka kalinlasma, dikdortgen hucreler r0.35, ped + soket; model +0.2.
  2. Recine baski -> vakum dokum cinkosuz 14K; yolluk ped arkasina.
  3. Tesviye, 10x gozenek, hucre temizligi (egri tabanda doku yok); pronotum oluklari mineden once.
  4. Seri oncesi pilot: ayni alasim + ayni dokumhaneden renk basina kupon, P1-P4 cevrimiyle pisirilir; igne deligi, kabarcik, catlak ve renk tonu gecmeden uretim yok.
  5. Yuzey zenginlestirme (depletion gilding) x3-4: ~593 C -> %10 H2SO4 pickle -> durulama (yalniz mineden ONCE; sonra asit yok).
  6. Islak dolum 1. sarj ince (derin yesim yesili, iki hucre) -> kurut -> P1 780 C x 1:30 dk (kalibre pirometre, firin termokupl kontrolu).
  7. 2. sarj -> P2 780 C x 1:30 dk.
  8. 3. sarj (jant ustune hafif tasan) -> P3 780 C x 1:30 dk.
  9. Su altinda alundum tas/elmas pedle mineyi jant kotuna (0-0.05 mm alti) DUZ taslama; hucre kenarinda cip kontrolu.
  10. P4 parlatma pisirimi 770 C x 1:00 dk (toplam 4 pisirim, hepsi <=780 C).
  11. Hafif sitrik pickle + durulama (H2SO4/HNO3 banyo YOK).
  12. Mineyi Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siperle maskele; Stuller 1800 sert civiyi ped soketine (Ø0.8 x 0.5) oturt, dusuk guc lazer, hava nozuluyla sogut (Staley yontemi).
  13. Civi testi: penseyle cekerken yarim-tam tur burgu (Revere) -> is sertlestirme + kaynak testi; civi dikligi 90 +-3 derece.
  14. El cilasi bas/pronotum/kenar; mine maskeli; ultrasonik yok.
  15. QC: cift 1.66 g +-0.05; omurga 0.70 surekliligi; mine 10x.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari, CINKOSUZ 'enamelable' dokum alasimi (Otto Frei 846-180 no-zinc master alloy ile alasimlanmis; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + DSC solidus), vakum/inert gaz dokum; dokum metali ~1.19 g/cift (govde x 1.15)
  • Mine: <=780 C'de olgunlasan kursunsuz yumusak opak mine (or. Soyer soft serisi), renk basina kupon; renk: derin yesim yesili; pisirilmis ~35 mg/cift
  • 2 x Stuller 1800 14KY sert cekme friction civi 0.76 x 11.1 mm (0.0658 g/adet = 0.132 g)
  • 2 x 14K sari friction arkalik 5-6.3 mm (0.25 g/adet VARSAYIM = 0.50 g; KANIT 0.2-0.4 g kaynaksiz - tedarikci numunesi tartilmadan CAD onayi yok)
  • GRAM DOKUMU (cift, x2 x 0.01307 g/mm3): skarabe silueti 37.23 mm2 x 0.9 x 1.024: +34.31 mm3 -> +0.8969 g; elytra arka kalinlasma 22.48 mm2 x 0.5 x 1.024: +11.51 mm3 -> +0.3009 g; 2 hucre dikdortgen 1.55x3.75 r0.35 = 2 x 5.71 mm2 x 0.6 x 1.024: -7.01 mm3 -> -0.1833 g; pronotum 2 oluk: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0065 g; civi pedi O2.2 x 0.3: +1.14 mm3 -> +0.0298 g; civi soketi: -0.25 mm3 -> -0.0066 g; civi 2 x Stuller 1800 0.76x11.1 = 0.1316 g; arkalik 2 x 0.25 g (varsayim) = 0.50 g => govde 1.0311 g, ALTIN 1.663 g (bant 1.40-1.75, tavana pay 0.087 g)

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Gram sapmasi (duz plaka formulu)Gelisim alani x kalinlik (1.024) + tek tanimli dikdortgen hucre alani 5.71 mm2.
Egri yuzeyde minenin kenardan incelmesiTek egrilik, 0.5 mm yukselti; hucre duvarlari dik 0.6; ince sarjlar.
Omurga duvarinin sarkmasiOmurga 0.70, <=780 C.
Civi tavlanmasi / lazer catlagiPisirim sonrasi sert civi, ped hucreden 1.63 mm, maske.

Tolerans

KuralDeğer
L1 karat + cinkosuz14K, Zn=0✓
L2 hucre 0.6 derin, >=0.7 gen.0.6 / 1.55 mm✓
L2 hucre arasi + cevre duvar >=0.70omurga 0.70, jant 0.70✓
L2 taban >=0.80.8 mm✓
L2 renk1: derin yesim yesili✓
L2/KANIT pisirim <=4, <=780 C780/780/780/770 C✓
L3/KANIT ped-hucre plan >=1.51.63 mm✓
L5 yapisal >=0.8, oluk sonrasi >=0.6kabuk 0.9; 0.65✓
L6 hollow yokkalinlasma arka yuzde, kapali bosluk yok✓
L7 cift altin 1.40-1.751.663 g✓
L9 stud <=129.25 mm✓
L12 tek kahramanyesil kanatli skarabe✓

14K Gold Star Lapel Pin for Men, Eight Point North Star, Groomsman Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold lapel pin, mens lapel pin, star lapel pin, north star pin, gold brooch for men, suit pin, groomsman gift, celestial jewelry, christmas gift, gift for him, solid gold pin, wedding lapel pin, mens jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

An eight-pointed star for the lapel, four long rays and four short ones, each with a bright cut groove and a matte centre. A Christmas gift for him, and the pin he wears to every wedding after.

THE PIECE
26 mm wide and 30 mm tall; the lower ray is drawn longest. Each ray is 1.3 mm thick with a flat top and one bright V groove that fades before the rounded tip. The 8 mm centre disc is honed matte with a small polished dome.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.33 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.33 g in total with everything on it.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

26.0 x 30.0 mm. Gobek D8.0 x 1.4 (deliksiz), merkez kubbe D2.6 h0.3. Kardinal isinlar (ust/sol/sag) gobek kenarindan 9.0 (R13), alt isin 13.0 (R17); plan 3.4 -> 0.8, uc r0.4, DIKDORTGEN kesit 1.3 sabit. Diyagonal isinlar 5.5 (R9.5), 2.6 -> 0.8, 1.2. On yuz V: 90 derece, 0.4 derin, 0.8 genis; isin 1.4 mm'ye daralinca (kardinal 6.9, alt 10.0, diyagonal 3.7 mm) 1.1 mm'de sifira sonumlenir; V altinda kalan ag 0.9. Model: bitmis + 0.2, elmas tirasli on yuzde +0.1 (isin modeli 1.6 kalin). Igne hatti yatay isinlar ekseninde (y=0), mafsal x=-6, kilit x=+6, igne 14.5 mm.

Tek parca 14K kayip-mum dokum: yildiz + mafsal kulaklari (sol yatay isin arkasi) ayni mumdan. Mine yok, tas yok, firina girmez. Emniyetli doner kilit dokulemez (doner kovan ayri parca) -> satin alma 14KY kilit, sag yatay isin arkasina (isin genisligi 2.8, kalinlik 1.3) lazerle kaynaklanir; parca hic firina girmedigi icin sert lehim de serbest ama lazer secildi (isil tav yok, renk dikisi yok). Igne 14K beyaz (nikelli), is-sertlestirilmis, kulaklara soguk percinlenir. Hollow yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis olculer + 0.2 bitirme payi; on yuz +0.1 elmas tiras payi (isin modeli 1.6 kalin); V oluk modelde YOK (tezgahta kesilir), uc r0.4.
  2. 2. Recine baski (DLP 25-50 um), destekler arka yuzde; besleme gobek arkasindan + alt isin kokune yardimci kanal.
  3. 3. Yatirim, kademeli yakma (recine ~730 C'ye kadar); 14K standart alasim vakum dokum, metal ~1060-1080 C, flaska ~600 C.
  4. 4. Yolluk kesimi, tesviye (ege, 600-1200 zimpara); isin kalinligi kumpasla 1.30 +/- 0.05 (V oncesi 1.4).
  5. 5. Gobek honlama (3M radial 220), merkez kubbe parlatma.
  6. 6. Elmas tiras: on yuz V, 90 derece uc, 0.4 derin; V isin 1.4 genislige inince 1.1 mm'de sonumlenir; sonrasi ag kalinligi >=0.85 kontrol.
  7. 7. Kilit: sag yatay isin arkasi r=6 noktasina 14KY 460-12 kilit lazer kaynagi (0.2-0.3 mm noktalar, argon); kilit sabun+amonyakli suda kaynatilir (Otto Frei notu).
  8. 8. Igne: 14KW 0.86 mm, 14.5 mm'ye kes, ucu konik bile, cekerek 1/2 tur burgu ile sertlestir; 0.8 mm 14K percinle kulaklara tak; kilide 1 mm on gerilimle oturt.
  9. 9. Cila (yalniz kenar ve gobek kubbe), tambur YOK (V keskinligi korunur).
  10. 10. QC: tartim 3.31 g +/- %5, uc yaricaplari >=0.4 (parmak testi), kilit 20 ac-kapa, igne cekme testi 2 kg, kumastan gecirme.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; firina girmez), vakum dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 2.940 g x 1.15 = 3.38 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Tas: yok.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 14.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.125 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.365 g (altin grama dahil).

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Elmas tiras V'sinin isin ucunu yarmasi (orijinalde 0.8 uc genisligine 0.8 genis V)V, isin 1.4 mm'ye daralinca 1.1 mm'de sifira sonumlenir; uc 0.8 genis tam kesit kalir.
Iki yuzlu V ile agin 0.5 mm'ye inmesi ve isinin kirilmasiYalniz on yuz V; ag 0.9 >= 0.8 yapisal.
Iginin gobekteki acik delikten onden gorunmesi (orijinal D2.6 delik igne hattinin tam ustunde)Gobek deligi kaldirildi; gobek kati, merkez parlak kubbe.
Parcanin yakada one devrilmesiAlt isin 13 mm (diger kardinal 9 mm) -> kutle merkezi y=-0.6, igne hatti y=0 ustte kalir.
Dar isin tabaninda kilidin tasmasiKilit r=6'da (isin 2.8 genis); kilit tabani 2.8'e egelenir.

Başlık 83/140

14K Gold Comet Brooch, Three Lab Grown Sapphires, Shooting Star Pin, Celestial Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold brooch, comet brooch, shooting star pin, lab grown sapphire, celestial jewelry, star brooch, gold pin, coat brooch, christmas gift, gift for her, solid gold brooch, statement brooch, astronomy gift

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, lab grown white sapphire, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

A comet lying across the coat: an open gold ring for a head and three tapered gold ribbons trailing behind, with lab-grown white sapphires at the head and on the cross-bars. A celestial Christmas gift.

THE PIECE
42 mm long and 14 mm tall. The 11 mm head ring holds a central collet on three short spokes; the three tail ribbons are 31, 25 and 19 mm long with rounded tips, bridged by two small cross-bars. Ribbon tops are diamond-cut, the sides honed matte.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.92 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.93 g in total with the stones.

STONES
Three 1.8 mm round lab-grown white sapphires: one in the head collet and one flush set on each cross-bar pad, 0.07 ct in total. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
Two pin stems of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Take it off for swimming and cleaning. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

42 x 14 mm. Bas halkasi OD11.0 / ID8.4, 1.8 kalin; 3 parmak 2.7 x 1.0 x 1.5; merkez kolet OD2.8 x 1.8. Seritler 31 / 25 / 19 boy, plan 2.4 -> 0.8 (uc r0.4), kalinlik 1.1 / 1.0 / 0.9; sirtta 0.25 elmas tiras pahi. Dugum 1: bastan 9 mm, uc seridi baglar (31'in 0.29'u, 19'un 0.47'si). Dugum 2: bastan 17 mm, 31 ve 25 seritlerini baglar (0.55 / 0.68). Dugum 2.8 x 2.8 x 1.8. Iki igne, her biri 14.5 mm, araliklari 18 mm, ust kenar seridinin arkasinda (ust ucte). Model +0.2, elmas tiras yuzu +0.1.

Tek parca 14K dokum (bas + parmaklar + kolet + 3 serit + 2 dugum + 2 cift mafsal kulagi). Mine yok, firina girmez. Taslar: kolet ve dugumlerde 1.8 mm lab beyaz safir, alttan D1.0 delikli flush. 2 kilit satin alma, lazerle; igneler 14KW soguk percin. Hollow yok.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; serit sirti +0.1 (elmas tiras); tas yuvalari D1.0 pilot delik modelde (derinlik/cap 1.8), uc r0.4.
  2. 2. Recine baski; besleme bas halkasi arkasi + her serit kokune; ince 0.9 serit icin uc tarafina hava kanali.
  3. 3. Yatirim + yakma; 14K standart alasim vakum dokum.
  4. 4. Yolluk kesimi, tesviye; serit kalinliklari 1.1 / 1.0 / 0.9 +/- 0.05; dugum kalinligi 1.8.
  5. 5. Elmas tiras: serit sirtlarinda 2 x 0.25 pah; yan yuzler honlu.
  6. 6. Tas yuvasi: pilot D1.0 teyit, 1.8 mm yuva frezesi (90 derece hart bur), girdle oturma 0.02 bindirme.
  7. 7. Tas oturtma: 3 x 1.8 lab beyaz safir flush, burnisor ile; tas sonrasi delikten isik kontrolu.
  8. 8. 2 kilit lazer kaynak (ust kenar seridi arkasi), 2 igne 14.5 mm burgu-sertlestirme + percin.
  9. 9. Cila; QC: tartim 3.79 g +/- %5, tas sallanma testi (igne ucu), serit ucu egilme kontrolu, 2 kilit ac-kapa.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari standart dokum alasimi (minesiz parca; firina girmez), vakum dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.059 g x 1.15 = 3.52 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: yok.
  • Taslar: 3 x 1.8 mm lab grown white sapphire = 0.0740 ct.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 2 x 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 14.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.125 g; 2 x 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 2 x 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.730 g (altin grama dahil).

Etsy metni

Başlık 81/140

14K Gold Icicle Brooch, Ice Blue Enamel Bar Pin, Lab Grown Sapphires, Winter Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold brooch, icicle brooch, enamel brooch, ice blue enamel, vitreous enamel, winter jewelry, bar brooch, lab grown sapphire, christmas gift, gift for her, coat brooch, solid gold brooch, ice jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

A gold bar with four fields of ice-blue glass enamel and three lab-grown sapphires, and three icicles hanging below it. A winter brooch for Christmas that stays on the coat until spring.

THE PIECE
28 mm wide and 26 mm tall. The bar is 3.9 mm tall; the icicles hang 22, 17 and 15 mm, each with a narrow open slit in its upper half and a rounded tip. Icicle faces are diamond-cut.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.71 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.78 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with polished gold borders.

STONES
Three 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, flush set between the enamel fields. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

28.0 x 25.9 mm. Bar 28.0 x 3.9 x 1.5. Hucreler 4 x (4.3 x 2.5 x 0.55); uc duvar 0.75, yan duvar 0.70, ayirici 3.1 (tas yuvasi). Sarkitlar x = -9 / 0 / +8 konumunda; 22 / 17 / 15 boy, plan 3.4 -> 0.8 (uc r0.4), kalinlik 1.1 / 1.0 / 1.0. Yarik 0.6 genis, bar altindan 3.6 mm'de baslar, sarkit 1.8 mm'ye daralinca biter (22: 3.6->13.5, 17: 3.6->10.5, 15: 3.6->9.2), uclari r0.3. Igne hatti bar altindan 2.1 mm (sarkit koklerinde), mafsal sol sarkit, kilit sag sarkit; igne 19.5 mm.

Tek parca 14K CINKOSUZ alasim dokum: bar + 4 hucre + 3 sarkit + mafsal kulaklari + kilit pedi. Lehim yok. Taban 1.5 - 0.55 = 0.95 (karsi-mine gerekmez). Kilit pedi sag sarkit kokunde, mine kenarina duzlemde 1.55 mm (KANIT >=1.5), pisirim sonrasi lazer. Taslar tum pisirimlerden sonra ayiricilarda, mine kenarina 0.8.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; hucre tabani filetosu r0.15; tas pilot delikleri D0.9 modelde (derinlik/cap 1.67); yarik uclari r0.3.
  2. 2. Recine baski; besleme bar arkasi ortadan; sarkit uclarina hava kanali.
  3. 3. Yatirim + yakma; CINKOSUZ 14K, vakum dokum. Gozenek kontrolu (10x lup, hucre tabanlari); gozenekli parca hurda.
  4. 4. Tesviye; bar kalinligi 1.5, hucre derinligi 0.55 derinlik saatiyle; yariklar 0.6 pin-gauge.
  5. 5. Hucre temizligi (cam firca, doku yok), tas yuvalarinin on frezesi (mineden ONCE; pisirim sonrasi titresim mineye ulasmasin).
  6. 6. Yuzey zenginlestirme: 3-4 dongu ~593 C tav + %10 H2SO4; damitik su, yagsiz.
  7. 7. Karsi-mine: gerekmez (taban 0.95 >= 0.8).
  8. 8. Islak dolum opak buz mavisi; Pisirim 1: 780 C, 75 sn, kalibre pirometre, sehpada bar alttan destekli.
  9. 9. Pisirim 2: ikinci dolum, 780 C, 75 sn.
  10. 10. Tasla zimpara (alundum + su), mine altinla es seviye.
  11. 11. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 50 sn parlatma. Toplam 3.
  12. 12. Asit YOK; bikarbonat + su notr temizlik.
  13. 13. Sarkitlarda elmas tiras (mineye torna yaklasmaz; sarkitlar bar altinda).
  14. 14. Tas oturtma: 3 x 1.5 lab beyaz safir flush, burnisorle elle (cekic YOK, mine yaninda); mine Plasti-tac ile maskeli.
  15. 15. Pisirim sonrasi lazer: sag sarkit kok pedine 460-12 kilit; Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siper, dusuk guc, hava sogutma.
  16. 16. Igne 14KW 19.5 mm burgu-sertlestir, sol sarkit kulaklarina percin.
  17. 17. Cila (yalniz altin), QC: tartim 3.68 g +/- %5, mine pinhole/catlak 10x, tas testi, kilit 20 ac-kapa.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.273 g x 1.15 = 3.76 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak buz mavisi ~148 mg (pisirilmis 59 mg x 2.5 dolum/tas kaybi).
  • Taslar: 3 x 1.5 mm lab grown white sapphire = 0.0428 ct.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 19.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.163 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.403 g (altin grama dahil).

Etsy metni

Başlık 71/140

14K Gold Ice Crystal Lapel Pin for Men, Blue Enamel, Lab Grown Sapphire

Etiketler (13)

14k gold lapel pin, mens lapel pin, ice crystal pin, hexagon lapel pin, enamel lapel pin, ice blue enamel, vitreous enamel, lab grown sapphire, gold brooch for men, suit pin, christmas gift, gift for him, winter jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown blue sapphire, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

A gold hexagon split by three ribs into three fields of ice-blue glass enamel, with a pale blue lab-grown sapphire where the ribs meet. An ice crystal for the lapel, and a Christmas gift for him.

THE PIECE
18 mm across the corners and 15.6 mm across the flats, 1.45 mm thick, with a 1.0 mm polished gold rim and rounded corners.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.70 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.91 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with the gold ribs.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab-grown sapphire in a pale ice blue, flush set in the centre disc. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

Altigen R9.0 (kose-kose 18.0, kenar-kenar 15.6), plaka 1.45; cevre altin cerceve 1.0; 6 kaburga 0.8 genis, gobek D3.4 (arkadan +0.15 -> 1.6). 6 ucgen hucre, toplam 120.6 mm2 x 0.55 derin; hucre koseleri r0.4 (60 derece kose min 0.7 genislik). Kose r0.5. Igne hatti y=+2.0, mafsal x=-5.5, kilit kaidesi x=+5.5; igne 13.5 mm. Model +0.2.

Tek parca 14K CINKOSUZ dokum: altigen plaka + kaburgalar + gobek + yukseltilmis mafsal kulaklari + kilit kaynak kaidesi. Lehim yok. Taban 1.45 - 0.55 = 0.90 (karsi-mine yok). Tum yuz mineli oldugu icin kilit, D1.6 x 1.2 ayak + 2.6 x 2.6 x 0.8 pedli dokum kaideye lazerle: kaynak yuzu mineye 3D en az 0.90 + 1.2 + 0.8 = 2.9 mm (KANIT >=1.5). Lab mavi safir gobekte, tum pisirimlerden sonra.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; hucre tabani r0.15 fileto, 60 derece hucre koseleri r0.4; gobek pilot delik D0.9; kaide ve uzun kulaklar arka yuzde.
  2. 2. Recine baski; besleme kilit kaidesinden degil, plaka kenarindan (kaide ayagi ince).
  3. 3. Yatirim + yakma; CINKOSUZ 14K vakum dokum; gozenek kontrolu (6 hucre tabani), gozenekli hurda.
  4. 4. Tesviye; plaka 1.45, hucre 0.55; kaburga 0.8 kumpas.
  5. 5. Hucre temizligi; gobek tas yuvasi on frezesi.
  6. 6. Yuzey zenginlestirme 3-4 dongu (~593 C + %10 H2SO4).
  7. 7. Karsi-mine: gerekmez (taban 0.90).
  8. 8. Islak dolum opak buz mavisi; Pisirim 1: 780 C, 75 sn.
  9. 9. Pisirim 2: 780 C, 75 sn.
  10. 10. Tasla zimpara, mine-kaburga es seviye.
  11. 11. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 50 sn parlatma. Toplam 3.
  12. 12. Asit yok; notr temizlik.
  13. 13. Gobege 1.5 lab mavi safir, burnisorle flush (cekic yok).
  14. 14. Lazer: kaide pedine 460-12 kilit; Plasti-tac + parlak gumus siper; dusuk guc, hava sogutma.
  15. 15. Igne 14KW 13.5 mm burgu-sertlestir, percin.
  16. 16. Cila (cerceve), QC: tartim 3.83 g +/- %5, 6 hucre pinhole, kilit testi.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.474 g x 1.15 = 4.00 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak buz mavisi ~415 mg (pisirilmis 166 mg x 2.5).
  • Tas: 1 x 1.5 mm lab grown blue sapphire = 0.0143 ct.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 13.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.118 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.357 g (altin grama dahil).

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Genis mine alaninda (121 mm2) firinda plaka carpilmasi6 kaburga + cerceve plakayi rijitler; taban 0.90; 780 C ust sinir; sehpada duz destek.
Dar 60 derece hucre kosesinde mine dolmamasi / catlakKoseler r0.4 (min genislik 0.7).
Kilit kaynaginin mineyi kavurmasi (yuzun tamami mine)Kaynak yuzu 2.9 mm yukseltilmis kaidede; maske + siper; kuponla dogrulama.
Uzun mafsal kulaginin igne kaldiracindan egilmesiKulak 1.0 x 2.4 kesit (L5 >=1.0), 4.2 boy; igne yalniz 13.5.

Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece. Two pins keep a 30 mm piece level on the lapel.

Başlık 87/140

14K Gold Stirrup Brooch, Jade Green Enamel, Lab Grown Sapphire, Equestrian Gift for Her

Etiketler (13)

14k gold brooch, stirrup brooch, equestrian jewelry, enamel brooch, green enamel, vitreous enamel, lab grown sapphire, horse lover gift, riding jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, coat brooch, solid gold brooch

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

A riding stirrup in 14k gold, its tread lined with jade-green glass enamel and a lab-grown sapphire set below the strap loop. An equestrian Christmas gift that is worn all year.

THE PIECE
26 mm tall and 22 mm wide. A polished 2.0 mm arch rises from an 18 by 4.4 mm tread to a small round strap loop; the enamel runs in one 14 mm channel along the tread.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.74 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.80 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade green, level with the gold.

STONES
One 2.0 mm round lab-grown white sapphire, flush set in a raised block on the arch. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

26 x 22 mm. Kemer OD22 / ID18 x 1.4, dairenin %60'i. Tepe bossu 3.4 x 3.0 x 2.0 (tas ev sahibi 2.0). Basamak 18.0 x 4.4 x 1.5; olugun 14.0 x 2.8 x 0.55; yan duvar 0.8, uc duvar 2.0; taban 0.95. Kayis gozu OD5.5 / ID3.1 x 1.2. Igne hatti ust ucte, mafsal sol kemer kolu, kilit sag kemer kolu; igne 18.5 mm. Model +0.2.

Tek parca 14K CINKOSUZ dokum. Lehim yok. Mine basamakta, tas kemer tepesinde (mineden ~20 mm), kilit pedi kemer kolunda (mineden >10 mm, duz ped, kaide gerekmez). Taban 0.95 (karsi-mine yok). Tas ve kilit pisirimlerden sonra.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; olugun tabani r0.15; boss pilot D1.0.
  2. 2. Recine baski; besleme basamak arkasi.
  3. 3. Yatirim + yakma; CINKOSUZ 14K vakum dokum; gozenek kontrolu (olugun tabani).
  4. 4. Tesviye; basamak 1.5, olugun 0.55; boss 2.0.
  5. 5. Olugun temizligi; boss yuvasi on frezesi.
  6. 6. Yuzey zenginlestirme 3-4 dongu (~593 C + %10 H2SO4).
  7. 7. Karsi-mine: gerekmez (taban 0.95).
  8. 8. Islak dolum opak derin yesil; Pisirim 1: 780 C, 75 sn; sehpada basamak alttan.
  9. 9. Pisirim 2: 780 C, 75 sn.
  10. 10. Tasla zimpara.
  11. 11. Pisirim 3: 770 C, 50 sn. Toplam 3.
  12. 12. Notr temizlik (asit yok); kemer parlatma, kayis gozu honlama.
  13. 13. 2.0 lab mavi safir flush (tepe bossu).
  14. 14. Lazer: sag kemer kolu pedine 460-12 kilit (mine 10 mm uzakta; yine de maske).
  15. 15. Igne 14KW 18.5 mm burgu-sertlestir, percin.
  16. 16. QC: tartim 3.54 g +/- %5, mine pinhole, tas, kilit.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.142 g x 1.15 = 3.61 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak derin yesil ~135 mg (pisirilmis 54 mg x 2.5).
  • Tas: 1 x 2.0 mm lab grown blue sapphire = 0.0338 ct.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 18.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.156 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.395 g (altin grama dahil).

Etsy metni

Başlık 89/140

14K Gold Evil Eye Brooch, Nazar Enamel Sunburst Pin, Lab Grown Sapphires, Protection Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold brooch, evil eye brooch, nazar brooch, enamel brooch, vitreous enamel, sunburst brooch, lab grown sapphire, protection amulet, talisman jewelry, christmas gift, gift for her, coat brooch, solid gold brooch

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

An evil eye in ice-blue, white and navy glass enamel at the centre of eight gold rays, with a lab-grown sapphire at the base of each diagonal ray. A protection gift for Christmas and every day after.

THE PIECE
23 mm across. The eye disc is 12 mm across; the eight rays are 5.5 mm long with rounded tips and bright diamond-cut faces.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.63 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.73 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque, in three rings divided by 0.7 mm gold walls: ice blue outside, then white, then a navy-blue centre.

STONES
Four 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, flush set at the ray bases. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

OD23. Disk D12.0 x 1.4. Halkalar: cevre altin r5.3-6.0 (0.7), buz mavisi r4.3-5.3 (1.0), altin r3.6-4.3 (0.7), beyaz r2.6-3.6 (1.0), altin r1.9-2.6 (0.7), lacivert bebek D3.8. Hucre 0.55, taban 0.85. 8 isin 5.5 boy, 2.8 -> 0.8 (uc r0.4), 1.2 kalin; 4 diyagonal isin kokunde 2.6 x 2.2 yerel boss (1.6). Tas merkezi r6.85. Igne hatti y=+1.5, mafsal x=-4.0, kilit kaidesi x=+4.0 (ikisi de disk arkasinda r<=6.0); igne 10.5 mm. Model +0.2, isin yuzu +0.1.

Tek parca 14K CINKOSUZ dokum. Lehim yok. 3 renk tek dolumda, 3 pisirim. Disk arkasi mine altinda oldugu icin kilit D1.6 x 1.2 + 2.6 x 2.6 x 0.8 kaideye lazer (3D mineye 0.85 + 2.0 = 2.85 mm). Taslar isin kokunde ciplak altinda, mineye 0.8, tum pisirimlerden sonra.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.281 g x 1.15 = 3.77 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu (toplam ~210 mg): opak buz mavisi ~104 mg, opak beyaz ~67 mg, opak lacivert ~39 mg (pisirilmis x 2.5).
  • Taslar: 4 x 1.5 mm lab grown white sapphire = 0.0571 ct.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 10.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.095 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.335 g (altin grama dahil).

Etsy metni

Başlık 70/140

14K Gold Robin Lapel Pin for Men, Berry Enamel, Lab Grown Sapphire Eye

Etiketler (13)

14k gold lapel pin, mens lapel pin, robin pin, bird lapel pin, enamel lapel pin, berry enamel, vitreous enamel, lab grown sapphire, gold brooch for men, suit pin, christmas gift, gift for him, winter bird

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

A robin on a perch, its breast in deep berry glass enamel and its eye a lab-grown white sapphire. A winter bird for the lapel, and a Christmas gift for him.

THE PIECE
24 mm long and 18 mm tall. The robin faces left on a 16 mm perch bar; four matte feather ridges cross its back and the 10 mm tail points down and back with two open slits. Beak, feet and perch are polished.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.53 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.58 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep berry, cadmium-free, level with the gold.

STONES
One 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphire, flush set as the eye. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

24 x 18 mm. Govde elips 12.0 x 9.5 x 1.4; gogus hucresi elips 8.0 x 5.0 x 0.55 (taban 0.85, cevre duvar >=0.8). Bas D7.0 x 1.4, goz bossu D3.0 (1.5). Gaga 3.0 x 1.6 x 1.2 r0.4. Kuyruk 10.0 boy, 4.8 -> 3.6, 1.0; ust kenar omurgasi 1.2 x 1.2; 2 yarik 0.6 x 6.0. Tunek 16.0 x 1.4 x 1.4 (uc r0.7), ayaklar 2 x 2.5 x 1.0 x 1.0. Igne hatti ust ucte: mafsal bas arkasi, kilit govde ust-arka (gogus hucresine duzlemde 2.0); igne 14.5 mm. Model +0.2.

Tek parca 14K CINKOSUZ dokum. Lehim yok. Plan dolgu katsayisi yerine acik geometrik govde (elips + daire + ucgen + yamuk). Mine yalniz gogus; bogurtlen tek renk, bandin alt ucunda. Goz tasi bas bossunda (mineden uzak), kilit duz pedde, pisirimlerden sonra.

Tezgâh sırası

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; acik geometri (elips govde, daire bas); hucre tabani r0.15; goz pilot D0.9; kuyruk yarik uclari r0.3.
  2. 2. Recine baski; besleme govde arkasi; kuyruk ucuna hava kanali.
  3. 3. Yatirim + yakma; CINKOSUZ 14K vakum dokum; gozenek kontrolu.
  4. 4. Tesviye; plaka 1.4, hucre 0.55, kuyruk 1.0 / omurga 1.2.
  5. 5. Hucre temizligi; goz yuvasi on frezesi.
  6. 6. Yuzey zenginlestirme 3-4 dongu.
  7. 7. Karsi-mine: gerekmez (taban 0.85).
  8. 8. Islak dolum opak derin bogurtlen; Pisirim 1: 765 C, 80 sn.
  9. 9. Pisirim 2: 765 C, 80 sn.
  10. 10. Tasla zimpara.
  11. 11. Pisirim 3: 760 C, 60 sn. Toplam 3; hepsi bandin alt ucu.
  12. 12. Notr temizlik; tuy sirtlari matlama, gaga/ayak/tunek parlatma.
  13. 13. 1.5 lab beyaz safir goz, flush.
  14. 14. Lazer: govde ust-arka pedine 460-12 kilit; maske.
  15. 15. Igne 14KW 14.5 mm, percin.
  16. 16. QC: tartim 3.50 g +/- %5, renk kontrolu (bogurtlen kararmasi), kilit.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.136 g x 1.15 = 3.61 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak derin bogurtlen ~108 mg (pisirilmis 43 mg x 2.5); kadmiyum icerigi tedarikciden teyit.
  • Tas: 1 x 1.5 mm lab grown white sapphire = 0.0143 ct.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 14.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.125 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.365 g (altin grama dahil).

Arıza modları

ArızaTasarım nasıl önlüyor
Kuyruk kafesinin egilmesi (en uzak, ince eleman)Ust kenarda 1.2 x 1.2 omurga; yarik 3 -> 2 (teller >=0.6).
Goz tasinin arkadan cikmasi (orijinal 1.4 plaka, 0.48 taban)Goz bossu 1.5 (KANIT) + alttan delik.
Bogurtlen minenin yuksek isida kararmasiTek renk, 760-765 C, kisa sure; kupon.
Gram belirsizligi (orijinal 0.75 plan dolgu varsayimi)Acik geometrik govde; dolgu katsayisi yok.

Görsel promptları (16)
  1. 01Hero / arama küçük resmi: tek ürün, marka natürmortu, 4:3.Referanssız
    Quiet luxury editorial still-life product photography. Warm ivory linen ground, honed grey stone slab, a sliver of deep jade-green matte card. Soft directional window light from upper left, long soft shadow, shallow depth of field. Solid yellow gold with warm antique tone. Restrained heirloom mood. No text, no logo, no glitter, no Christmas decoration. The piece: Men's lapel pin in 14K yellow gold, 24 mm long and 18 mm tall: a robin in side profile facing left, standing on a 16 mm straight perch bar. The oval breast holds one 8 by 5 mm field of opaque deep berry enamel (a dark wine red, not bright red), level with the gold. The round 7 mm head has one 1.5 mm lab grown white sapphire eye, flush-set. Four raised feather ridges with a matte finish cross the upper back of the body. The 10 mm tail points steeply down and back to the right; it has two open slits and a solid top edge. Beak, feet and perch are polished. Back: 14K white gold pin stem with a rotating safety catch. The stones are exactly these and no others: one 1.5 mm round lab-grown white sapphire flush-set as the robin's eye. No other stone and no empty setting anywhere on the piece. The only colour on the piece is opaque deep berry enamel filling the single oval cell on the robin's breast; every other surface is yellow gold. The brooch lies face up, centred on the honed grey stone slab, pin hidden behind it; exactly one brooch. Seen from about 30 degrees above with a 100 mm macro lens, the piece in razor-sharp focus, filling about 45 percent of the frame width, centred with generous empty margin on all four sides. No people and no hands.

    Alt metin 14K gold robin lapel pin with a deep berry enamel breast

14K Gold Lantern Brooch, Ice Blue Enamel Roof, Lab Grown Sapphire Flame, Winter Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold brooch, lantern brooch, enamel brooch, ice blue enamel, vitreous enamel, lab grown sapphire, winter jewelry, candle brooch, christmas gift, gift for her, coat brooch, solid gold brooch, cozy gift

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, lab grown white sapphire, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

A small lantern in 14k gold: an ice-blue glass enamel roof, an open window, and a lab-grown white sapphire standing in for the flame. A winter-evening brooch for Christmas and the months after.

THE PIECE
25.6 mm tall and 15 mm wide. A round hanging ring sits on the triangular roof; two 1.4 mm posts frame an open window 11.2 by 12 mm, with a 1.0 mm gold rod rising to the stone at its centre.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.36 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.39 g in total with the enamel and stones.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with the gold roof edges.

STONES
One 1.8 mm round lab-grown white sapphire in a round tube collet, open at the back. Mohs 9.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel. The stones are set last, cold, after all firing and polishing.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

25.6 x 15.0 mm. Halka orta cap 3.0, kesit 1.0 x 1.0. Cati ucgeni 14.0 x 5.5 x 1.45; ucgen hucre 10.0 x 3.4 x 0.55 (taban 0.90, cevre duvar >=0.9). Sacak 15.0 x 1.4 x 1.4. Direkler 2 x 12.0 x 1.4 x 1.4; pencere 11.2 x 12.0 acik; alt ray 12.0 x 1.2 x 1.4; kaide 13.0 x 2.0 x 1.4. Alev cubugu 4.5 x 1.0 x 1.0; kolet tup OD2.8 x 1.7, arkasi D1.0 acik. Igne hatti sacak arkasinda (ust ucte); igne 13.0 mm. Model +0.2.

Tek parca 14K CINKOSUZ dokum, 2.5D (on gorunus), HOLLOW YOK. Lehim yok. Mine yalniz cati; tas pencere ortasinda (mineye ~8 mm). Kilit sacak arkasinda D1.6 x 1.2 + 2.6 x 2.6 x 0.8 kaideye lazer (cati hucresine 3D >=1.5).

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 2.992 g x 1.15 = 3.44 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: kursunsuz opak buz mavisi ~58 mg.
  • Tas: 1 x 1.8 mm lab grown white sapphire = 0.0247 ct.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 13.0 mm'ye kesilir) 0.114 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.354 g (altin grama dahil).

Etsy metni

Başlık 75/140

14K Gold Scarab Lapel Pin for Men, Green Blue Enamel Beetle, Good Luck Gift

Etiketler (13)

14k gold lapel pin, mens lapel pin, scarab pin, beetle lapel pin, enamel lapel pin, vitreous enamel, scarab amulet, good luck gift, gold brooch for men, suit pin, christmas gift, gift for him, talisman jewelry

Malzemeler

14k yellow gold, vitreous enamel, 14k white gold pin stem, 14k gold safety catch

Açıklama

A scarab for the lapel: a deep jade-green glass enamel shield, ice-blue enamel wing cases and six gold legs. The beetle of renewal and good luck, as a Christmas gift for him.

THE PIECE
22 mm long and 21 mm wide including the legs. A polished 1.0 mm gold ridge runs between the wing cases; the six 1.0 mm legs angle outward with rounded ends.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.91 g of 14k gold, counting the 14k white gold pin stem and the safety catch. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.00 g in total with the enamel.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque: deep jade green on the front shield, ice blue on the wing cases, level with the gold.

HOW IT FASTENS
One pin stem of hardened 14k white gold with a rotating safety catch, the standard fine-jewellery fastening for a brooch worn every day.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
Atölye kartı

22 x 21 mm (bacaklar dahil; govde 11 genis). Pronotum 10.0 x 5.0 x 1.4 (r2.0), yesil hucre 7.0 x 3.0 x 0.55. Elytra 2 x 12.0 x 5.0 x 1.4, mavi hucre 9.0 x 2.6 x 0.55 (yan duvar 1.2). Omurga 12.0 x 1.0 x 1.4. 6 bacak 7.0 x 1.0 x 1.0, yana ~45 derece, uc r0.5. Bas 4.0 x 2.5 x 1.2. Taban 0.85. Igne hatti pronotum-elytra sinirinda, mafsal x=-4.5, kilit kaidesi x=+4.5; igne 11.5 mm. Model +0.2.

Tek parca 14K CINKOSUZ dokum. Lehim yok. 2 renk ayni dolumlarda, 3 pisirim. Govde arkasi mine altinda -> kilit kaideye lazer (3D 0.85 + 2.0). Tas yok.

  1. 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; hucre tabani r0.15; bacak uclari r0.5; kaide + uzun kulaklar.

  5. 5. Hucre temizligi.

  7. 7. Karsi-mine: gerekmez (taban 0.85).

  9. 9. Pisirim 2: 780 C, 75 sn.

Malzeme listesi

  • Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi + solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Dokum govde (kulak/ped dahil) 3.600 g x 1.15 = 4.14 g dokum metali (yolluk/kayip payi).
  • Mine tozu: opak derin yesil ~72 mg, opak buz mavisi ~161 mg.
  • Tas: yok.
  • Bulgular (satin alma): 14K beyaz igne 0.86 mm (Otto Frei 601-14, 38.1 mm'den 11.5 mm'ye kesilir) 0.102 g; 14KY emniyetli doner kilit Otto Frei 460-12 0.22 g (tahmin); 14K percin teli 0.8 mm x 3.0 0.020 g. Toplam bulgu 0.342 g (altin grama dahil).
